alternativeSecurityFramework.mappingToFedRampRules:
Zeta maps the SOC 2 Type II report to the 23 mandatory
Class A rules (FRC-CLA-MFR) in the External Framework
Mapping on the trust center
(https://trust.paramify.com/zetaglobal/zeta-
global/controls/73974d0d-ddfc-4992-b32d-2699e0f4ec8d).
Summary:
1. Identity and access (KSI-IAM-AAM, KSI-IAM-APM). SOC
2 CC6.1 to CC6.3 cover provisioning, deprovisioning, and
access reviews. Automated account lifecycle and phishing-
resistant passwordless authentication for privileged users
are implemented through Okta and evidenced separately,
since SOC 2 does not require passwordless.
2. Network restriction (KSI-CNA-RNT). CC6.6 and CC6.7
cover boundary protection and transmission security.
Evidence: VPC security groups, deny-by-default network
policies, TLS 1.2 or higher.
3. Change logging (KSI-CMT-LMC). CC8.1 covers change
management. Evidence: pipeline and infrastructure change
logs tied to reviewed changes.
4. Training review (KSI-CED-RAT). CC1.4 and CC2.2 cover
security awareness training. Annual review of training
content is tracked separately.
5. Incident response (KSI-INR-RIR, IEC-CSO-EFR, IEC-
CSO-FIR). CC7.3 to CC7.5 cover incident detection,
response, and recovery. FedRAMP reportability evaluation,
PAIN rating, and the 3-business-day Final Incident Report
are FedRAMP-specific additions to the incident response
plan.
6. Securing information (KSI-SVC-SIN). CC6.1, CC6.7, and
C1.1 cover encryption at rest and in transit and
confidentiality of customer data.
7. Vulnerability detection (VDR-CSO-DET). CC7.1 and
CC7.2 cover vulnerability scanning and monitoring.
Evidence: AWS Inspector, dependency and container
scanning, annual penetration testing, and the Bugcrowd
vulnerability disclosure program.
8. Scope and third parties (MAS-CSO-IIR). CC9.2 covers
vendor risk management. The resource inventory in
Sections 6 and 8 is FedRAMP-specific.
9. Rules with no SOC 2 counterpart, implemented as new
FedRAMP processes: FRC-CSO-PKG, FRC-CSO-JSN,
FRC-CSO-POP, CDS-CSO-PUB, CDS-CSO-UTC, CDS-
UTC-AAD, AFC-CSO-INB, AFC-CSO-RCV, AFC-CSO-CRA,
CCM-OCR-AVL, CCM-OCR-NRD. These are met through
the Paramify trust center, the FedRAMP Security Inbox, and
the quarterly Ongoing Certification Report.
10. Annual assessment (IVV-CSX-AIA). The annual SOC 2
Type II audit is the persistent independent assessment for
Class A.

certified.fedRampCertifiedThirdPartyInformationRes:
AGENCYAMAZONEW (AWS US East/West, FedRAMP
Certified Class C (Moderate), Rev5, JAB path)
certified.useCase:
Sole IaaS provider for the ZMP-GOV certified set. No on-
premise or alternate cloud infrastructure is used.
certified.usageAndConfiguration:
Compute (Amazon EKS and EC2), object and block storage
(S3 and EBS), managed databases (Aurora), batch
processing (EMR), networking (VPC, load balancers), key
management (KMS), and logging (CloudTrail and
CloudWatch).
Deployed in AWS US East/West commercial regions within
Zeta's AWS Organization. Federal tenants run in the same
account structure as Zeta commercial production, with
logical separation by tenant identifier.
certified.justificationForUse:
Required to operate the offering. AWS US East/West holds
FedRAMP Certified Class C (Moderate), so the physical,
environmental, and hypervisor controls inherited from AWS
are covered by that certification. The AWS services used for
ZMP-GOV are within the AWS US East/West FedRAMP
scope.
certified.mitigationMeasures:
FIPS-validated service endpoints. Encryption at rest with
customer-managed KMS keys and in transit with TLS 1.2 or
higher. CIS Level 1 hardening on instances and container
images. Deny-by-default security groups and Kubernetes
network policies.
certified.compensatingControls:
Administrative access to AWS is through Okta SSO with
phishing-resistant passwordless authentication and role-
based IAM. Privileged sessions use AWS Systems Manager
Session Manager with session logging. CloudTrail and
CloudWatch logs are retained centrally and reviewed. AWS
Inspector scans hosts and images. Tenant data is separated
at the application and data-store layers.

certified.useCase:
Compliance documentation platform and FedRAMP-
compatible trust center.
certified.usageAndConfiguration:
SaaS. Holds the Certification Package Overview, the
Security Decision Record, the External Framework Mapping,
and evidence metadata; produces the machine-readable
(JSON) package; hosts the trust center at
https://trust.paramify.com/zetaglobal/zeta-global. Zeta
compliance staff sign in through SSO with MFA.
certified.justificationForUse:
Required to produce and publish certification data in human-
readable and JSON formats (FRC-CSO-PKG, FRC-CSO-
JSN) and to meet the trust center rule (CDS-CSO-UTC).
certified.mitigationMeasures:
No federal customer data is sent to Paramify. Content is
limited to security documentation, control narratives, and
evidence metadata.
certified.compensatingControls:
Zeta keeps responsibility for the accuracy of all published
information (FRC-CSO-MRA). Publication requires review by
the Security contact. Evidence integrations use least-
privilege, read-only credentials.

nonCertified.name: Okta IDaaS
nonCertified.useCase:
Workforce identity for privileged and administrative access
to the certified set.
nonCertified.usageAndConfiguration:
SSO, MFA, and phishing-resistant passwordless
authentication for Zeta staff accessing AWS, Kubernetes,
and ZMP-GOV administrative interfaces. Device posture and
session policies are applied.
nonCertified.justificationForUse:
Satisfies KSI-IAM-APM (passwordless), which is mandatory
at Class A. No alternate identity provider is in the certified
set.
nonCertified.mitigationMeasures:
Passwordless enrollment is required for all privileged roles.
Okta holds Zeta workforce identities only; no federal
customer data. Quarterly access reviews.
nonCertified.compensatingControls:
Account creation and removal are automated (KSI-IAM-
AAM), so departed staff lose access on termination.
Authentication and administrative events are sent to Zeta's
central log store and reviewed.

nonCertified.name: Snowflake (commercial regions)
nonCertified.useCase:
Cloud data warehouse for campaign performance and
engagement analytics supporting the certified Email
Marketing service.
nonCertified.usageAndConfiguration:
Deployed in Snowflake commercial regions on AWS. Access
restricted to named service accounts through SSO with
MFA. No public endpoint. Data flow is one-directional:
Snowflake is a reporting sink and does not write back into
campaign targeting or suppression logic.
nonCertified.justificationForUse:
Snowflake is the reporting warehouse for ZMP. Engagement
reporting for federal tenants uses the same warehouse.
nonCertified.mitigationMeasures:
Engagement records are keyed by ZID token; raw recipient
identifiers (such as email addresses) do not leave the
certified set. Federal tenant rows are separated by tenant
identifier under row access policies. Transport uses TLS 1.2
or higher.
nonCertified.compensatingControls:
Warehouse access is logged and reviewed. Service account
credentials are held in secrets management. Snowflake's
SOC 2 Type II report is reviewed under Zeta's vendor risk
process.

serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: CLEATUS is a cloud-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform that provides AI-powered government contracting business development and proposal support. Users discover and evaluate federal contracting opportunities, manage capture and pipeline activities, generate and refine proposal content, and automate recurring business development workflows. The system is hosted in AWS GovCloud (US), with us-gov-west-1 as the primary region and us-gov-east-1 as a warm standby, and it processes, stores, and transmits Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) for organizations that support the Department of Defense. The system does not process classified information.

Source control, code review, and the GitHub Actions builds that publish release images to the in-boundary Amazon ECR. FedRAMP Low, below the Moderate baseline. Compensating measures: the OIDC trust is scoped to the repository; branch protection and role-based access use SSO with multi-factor authentication; the ECR repositories are immutable; images are scanned by Amazon Inspector; and production pulls only from in-boundary ECR.
Identity provider for CLEATUS staff, with enforced multi-factor authentication, and staff email and documents.
Security awareness and role-based training for CLEATUS staff. It holds no system or customer data and has no connection to the boundary.

Governance, risk, and compliance platform where CLEATUS maintains its security plan, certification package, and control evidence. It receives approved compliance evidence from in-boundary collectors and holds no customer data.
Receives one-way security and operational alerts from in-boundary monitoring through incoming webhooks. No CUI is sent.

Collects compliance evidence through a read-only cross-account audit role. FedRAMP 20x Low, below the Moderate baseline. Compensating measures: the role requires an external ID, carries only read-only audit permissions, sessions last at most one hour, and CloudTrail records every call. It holds no customer data.

nonCertified.name: Commercial Public Data Bridge (Vercel)
nonCertified.useCase: Twice-daily one-way transfer of allowlisted public procurement data from the CLEATUS commercial environment into an in-boundary S3 bucket. It carries no CUI.

nonCertified.name: Have I Been Pwned Pwned Passwords API
nonCertified.useCase: Screens new passwords against known breached passwords. Only the first five characters of the SHA-1 digest leave the boundary.

nonCertified.name: Intercom Customer Support Messaging
nonCertified.useCase: Customer support messaging widget on the sign-in page and support interface. A persistent notice prohibits CUI in the channel, each messenger open requires a recorded CUI-prohibition attestation, and file attachment, drag and drop, and file paste are blocked.

nonCertified.name: npm Registry (build-time package fetch)
nonCertified.useCase: Supplies public JavaScript packages to the image build outside the boundary, pinned by a lockfile with integrity hashes. No data is sent to it.

nonCertified.name: Stripe Payment Processing
nonCertified.useCase: Payment processing. Card data goes from the browser directly to Stripe, and CLEATUS servers handle only Stripe object identifiers and billing metadata, with CUI prohibited in that metadata. Stripe is PCI DSS Level 1 with SOC 2 Type II.

frc-cso-pkg.x-relevantPoliciesAndProcedures: The 18 FedRAMP policies and 18 procedures in SSP Appendix C, version 1.1, approved with SSP 1.1 on 2026-09-29. The policy and procedure reference is published at https://trust.cleat.ai/policy-procedure-reference.json.
frc-cso-pkg.x-informationResources: The authorization boundary spans two AWS GovCloud (US) regions in one account: us-gov-west-1 is the primary region and us-gov-east-1 is a warm standby with its own load balancer, application services, Aurora Global Database reader, and S3 and ECR replicas. Application services run on ECS Fargate and Lambda behind WAF-protected Application Load Balancers. Customer data is stored in Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and Amazon S3. AI inference and document processing use Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, and Textract inside the boundary. Two EC2 hosts run the security monitoring and code analysis tools. Better Auth, the customer identity provider, runs inside the boundary.
frc-cso-pkg.x-informationFlows: The system is categorized Moderate under FIPS 199. Customer browsers connect over HTTPS to the WAF-protected public load balancer, which uses the TLS 1.3/1.2 FIPS policy and forwards to private application targets. Aurora and S3 protect stored customer data with customer-managed keys. Customer-directed workflow email sent through Amazon SES can carry customer content to entity members or to addresses that the customer sets. GitHub Actions publishes release images to Amazon ECR through an authorized role. A reviewed public-data workflow delivers non-CUI data one way into an ingest bucket. Vanta reads configuration through a read-only audit role. In-boundary collectors send approved compliance evidence to Paramify. Lambda forwarders send operational alert metadata to Slack through AWS Network Firewall.

Encryption keys for data at rest
TLS from the TLS sidecars, and from the pgroll migration engine to Aurora

frc-cso-pkg.x-assessmentSummary: A-LIGN (FedRAMP assessor ID 138665) is performing the independent assessment under SOW CON-011035. The 20x Class C assessment started on 2026-09-08 and is in progress. A-LIGN agreed on 2026-10-09 to re-test the controls that CLEATUS updated after its KSI Assessment Report v3.2 (2026-09-18); the re-test is pending. The overall assessment summary will be added when A-LIGN issues it.

changes: Session controls (2026-10-20 to 2026-10-26): Customer Admins can shorten the session inactivity window, end member sessions, and revoke connector authorizations; only user input extends a session.

Cryptography (2026-10-22 and 2026-10-27): every production Fargate task runs in FIPS-140 mode, Terraform-managed Lambda functions load the Amazon Linux 2023 OpenSSL FIPS Provider (CMVP 5021), and the migration image runs Node in FIPS mode with the OpenSSL FIPS Provider (CMVP 4985) and pgroll on the Go Cryptographic Module (CMVP 5247).

Identity provider (2026-10-26): Better Auth remains the only authentication provider in GovCloud; the release removed the unused Clerk placeholders and the provider switch. The significant change history withdraws the CHG-2026-08-14-TRF records, because GovCloud always ran Better Auth and no transformative change took place.

Vulnerability remediation (2026-10-22 to 2026-10-27): Node.js 24.22.1 and 22.23.4, which reject the compromised eMudhra intermediate CAs, and package updates for the Amazon Inspector findings on the application images.
Evidence collection (2026-10-28): a daily automated export collects the incident and vulnerability disclosure registers, and no GovCloud secret holds a GitHub token.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Authifi is an Authorization Management solution designed to help government and highly regulated organizations secure access to their most sensitive applications and data. Engineered from the ground up for healthcare, medical research and biopharma environments, Authifi includes identity and access management (IAM), ensuring that the right users get the right access, at the right time, for the right reasons—while automatically enforcing compliance with federal and industry cybersecurity standards.

AutogenAI is a Generative AI proposal management platform that supports capture through submission by automating research and sourcing, pWin go/no-go, requirement shredding and first-draft generation, reviewer workflows and compliance checks, and templated, auditable outputs for on-time, high-quality submissions.

C4G is Anthropic's AI chat assistant designed for highly regulated environments. Purpose-built to meet FedRAMP High security controls, it delivers Claude's advanced reasoning capabilities with enhanced security, administrative controls, and expanded context windows. Claude for Government seamlessly integrates into existing workflows while maintaining the data protection and compliance standards required for critical business processes in government agencies and other security-conscious organizations.

Cognition provides a suite of AI coding tools to accelerate developer productivity, including Cognition Plugins for popular IDEs as well as its own AI-native IDE, Devin Desktop. Cognition leverages state-of-the-art AI models and advanced context-awareness capabilities to deliver tools like fast autocomplete, codebase-aware Chat, and agentic coding capabilities. Enterprise developer teams rely on Cognition to increase developer velocity, reduce onboarding times, and reduce tech debt. Cognition was previously known as Windsurf and Codeium.

Ingests policy documents, prior approvals, and heuristics to orchestrate document review and approvals within the DOD, USG, IC, and other highly regulated entities. By atomizing policy statements into AI-enabled agents, rules, workflow steps, and document edits, the platform enables teams to accelerate and automate complex policy approvals. The software is data-agnostic, model-independent, and can be adapted to deploy into various customer environments, including classified settings.

Descope is a drag-and-drop platform to help organizations manage all their external identities. The no-code/low-code solution helps organizations create, modify, and secure authentication and authorization journeys for end users, business customers, partner applications, and APIs and AI agents.

Epsilon3 is software for complex engineering, assembly, manufacturing, testing, and operations. Its solutions for advanced process control support planning, tracking, and analyzing a wide range of complex operations and procedures from manufacturing and testing through operations and maintenance.

GovSignals.ai is an AI-driven platform designed to deliver real-time government intelligence and analytics from federal agencies and public records. Leveraging advanced generative and agentic AI, the platform identifies emerging trends, monitors policy shifts, and anticipates agency actions across federal and SLED procurement markets. For government contractors, GovSignals.ai automates the end-to-end proposal creation process. For government agencies, GovSignals streamlines acquisition operations by providing intelligent intake, evaluation screening, and project management tools powered by AI.

A fully managed, highly scalable observability platform, powered by Grafana Mimir for Prometheus metrics, Grafana Loki for logs, Grafana Tempo for traces, and Grafana, the de facto standard for data visualization.

An AI platform with a proprietary model-based architecture that reads and understands all forms of content with 99% accuracy and 98.5% automation, scaling across the enterprise while ensuring auditability, governance, and security using private enterprise data.

KODE OS is a FedRAMP High authorized, cloud-native building operations platform deployed within the Palantir FedStart environment that enables federal, state, local, and government contractor organizations to securely centralize, monitor, control, and optimize distributed facility infrastructure through unified data integration, real-time analytics, role-based access control, and automated operational workflows.

The Knightscope Security Operations Center (KSOC) is a user interface for law enforcement, security professionals, and remote monitoring teams to interact with autonomous systems utilized in physical security operations. The platform delivers both real-time visibility and investigative tools to help teams respond faster, reduce cost, and improve public safety.
Legion is a secure, modular agent orchestration platform that unifies mission data and workflows, deployable across classified, air-gapped, and edge environments.

The Method Platform is composed of integrations (cloud, endpoint, identity/directory services, and vulnerability scanners), tools (network, vulnerability, web, OSINT scanning, and validation), guardrails (operator-in-the-loop and on-the-loop breakpoints and approval workflows for AI-generated plans), data management (transforming raw tool and integration data into linked knowledge across a cyber ontology), and AI agents (to recommend work or execute tasks end-to-end). Together, these capabilities enable autonomous or semi-autonomous cyber operations across on-premises, cloud, and edge environments.

Oligo delivers runtime security for modern applications, cloud workloads, and AI systems. By analyzing application and infrastructure behavior in production, Oligo reveals what is actually running, identifies which vulnerabilities are truly exploitable, and detects malicious activity as it happens. Unlike traditional security tools that rely on static scanning or passive visibility, Oligo focuses on runtime behavior to detect real attacks and surgically block them at the first exploit attempt. This precision helps security teams cut through alert noise, protect critical systems from both known and unknown threats, and focus on the signals that matter most: what happens at runtime.
Legion is a cloud-native software built to provide platform-agnostic infrastructure for command and control capabilities.

Belisar (formerly Pryzm) provides the clearest view of federal growth, with an AI-native platform that brings together your CRM, global market intelligence, real-time opportunity data, and automated workflows tailored to your mission. Organizations across the public and private sector use Belisar as their unified system of record for government contracts and commercial deals — helping them see clearly, move faster, and win.

Skydio Federal Cloud is a software-as-a-service application used to manage and conduct unmanned aircraft operations. The system provides capabilities to organize users and roles, register and manage drones, and configure operational settings for flight activities. Operators use the system to plan and initiate drone flights, monitor flight status, view live and recorded video, and capture and review flight-associated data products. The system also provides historical records and audit-relevant information associated with user activity, device activity, and flight execution.

SmartPM is a cloud-native schedule analytics and risk intelligence platform purpose-built for the construction industry. It ingests raw scheduling data (.xer, .mpp, .xml, .ppx, .pp) and applies critical path method (CPM) logic, delay analysis frameworks, and earned value methodologies to surface risks, measure progress, and automate forensic-level oversight. SmartPM supports international standards in scheduling and delay analysis, offering defensible insights for audit, compliance, and performance monitoring of capital projects.
See your organization from the attacker's view. BloodHound Enterprise is an Attack Path Management solution that continuously maps and quantifies identity Attack Paths in Active Directory and Azure.

Streamline is the first third-party product deployable through Palantir Foundry, offering secure, offline-capable mobile data collection integrated with Foundry's infrastructure and ontology, enabling non-technical users to easily create and manage authenticated or public data intake tools.
The Unstructured Platform is an enterprise-grade ETL solution that automatically transforms complex, unstructured data into clean, structured data for GenAI applications.

HarborOS is a secure, modular software platform designed to enable distributed medical operations and data management in austere or disconnected environments. It integrates infrastructure monitoring, patient tracking, and logistics coordination within a FedRAMP-compliant cloud architecture to support Harbor Box facilities.

serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
PFCS-SS is a dedicated environment for the purpose of delivering best-of-breed commercial software to federal government customers as a secure cloud service at the FedRAMP High baseline. The software deployed to PFCS-SS is commercially available software configured to run on PFCS' Kubernetes infrastructure and leverage PFCS' management plane services.

## Certified Service Details

All services listed below are included in the PFCS-SS Minimum Assessment Scope at the High security category.

### [Authifi](https://axleinfo.com/)

Authifi is an Authorization Management solution designed to help government and highly regulated organizations secure access to their most sensitive applications and data.

Engineered from the ground up for healthcare, medical research and biopharma environments, Authifi includes identity and access management (IAM), ensuring that the right users get the right access, at the right time, for the right reasons—while automatically enforcing compliance with federal and industry cybersecurity standards.

### [AutogenAI Federal](https://www.autogenai.com/)

AutogenAI is a Generative AI proposal management platform that supports capture through submission by automating research and sourcing, pWin go/no-go, requirement shredding and first-draft generation, reviewer workflows and compliance checks, and templated, auditable outputs for on-time, high-quality submissions.

### [Belisar](https://www.pryzm.io/)

Belisar (formerly Pryzm) provides the clearest view of federal growth, with an AI-native platform that brings together your CRM, global market intelligence, real-time opportunity data, and automated workflows tailored to your mission. Organizations across the public and private sector use Belisar as their unified system of record for government contracts and commercial deals — helping them see clearly, move faster, and win.

### [Claude for Government (C4G)](https://www.anthropic.com/)

C4G is Anthropic's AI chat assistant designed for highly regulated environments. Purpose-built to meet FedRAMP High security controls, it delivers Claude's advanced reasoning capabilities with enhanced security, administrative controls, and expanded context windows.

Claude for Government seamlessly integrates into existing workflows while maintaining the data protection and compliance standards required for critical business processes in government agencies and other security-conscious organizations.

### [Cognition](https://cognition.com/)

Cognition provides a suite of AI coding tools to accelerate developer productivity, including Cognition Plugins for popular IDEs as well as its own AI-native IDE, Devin Desktop. Cognition leverages state-of-the-art AI models and advanced context-awareness capabilities to deliver tools like fast autocomplete, codebase-aware Chat, and agentic coding capabilities. Enterprise developer teams rely on Cognition to increase developer velocity, reduce onboarding times, and reduce tech debt.

Cognition was previously known as Windsurf and Codeium.

### [ConductorAI Conduit Platform](https://www.conductorai.co/)

Ingests policy documents, prior approvals, and heuristics to orchestrate document review and approvals within the DOD, USG, IC, and other highly regulated entities. By atomizing policy statements into AI-enabled agents, rules, workflow steps, and document edits, the platform enables teams to accelerate and automate complex policy approvals.

The software is data-agnostic, model-independent, and can be adapted to deploy into various customer environments, including classified settings.

### [Descope](https://www.descope.com/)

Descope is a drag-and-drop platform to help organizations manage all their external identities. The no-code/low-code solution helps organizations create, modify, and secure authentication and authorization journeys for end users, business customers, partner applications, and APIs and AI agents.

### [Epsilon3](https://www.epsilon3.io/)

Epsilon3 is software for complex engineering, assembly, manufacturing, testing, and operations. Its solutions for advanced process control support planning, tracking, and analyzing a wide range of complex operations and procedures from manufacturing and testing through operations and maintenance.

### [GovSignals](https://www.govsignals.ai/)

GovSignals.ai is an AI-driven platform designed to deliver real-time government intelligence and analytics from federal agencies and public records. Leveraging advanced generative and agentic AI, the platform identifies emerging trends, monitors policy shifts, and anticipates agency actions across federal and SLED procurement markets. For government contractors, GovSignals.ai automates the end-to-end proposal creation process.

For government agencies, GovSignals streamlines acquisition operations by providing intelligent intake, evaluation screening, and project management tools powered by AI.

### [Grafana Federal Cloud](https://grafana.com/)

A fully managed, highly scalable observability platform, powered by Grafana Mimir for Prometheus metrics, Grafana Loki for logs, Grafana Tempo for traces, and Grafana, the de facto standard for data visualization.

### [Hyperscience Hypercell](https://www.hyperscience.com/)

An AI platform with a proprietary model-based architecture that reads and understands all forms of content with 99% accuracy and 98.5% automation, scaling across the enterprise while ensuring auditability, governance, and security using private enterprise data.

### [KODE OS for Government](https://www.kodelabs.com/)

KODE OS is a FedRAMP High authorized, cloud-native building operations platform deployed within the Palantir FedStart environment that enables federal, state, local, and government contractor organizations to securely centralize, monitor, control, and optimize distributed facility infrastructure through unified data integration, real-time analytics, role-based access control, and automated operational workflows.

### [Knightscope Security Operations Center (KSOC)](https://www.knightscope.com/)

The Knightscope Security Operations Center (KSOC) is a user interface for law enforcement, security professionals, and remote monitoring teams to interact with autonomous systems utilized in physical security operations. The platform delivers both real-time visibility and investigative tools to help teams respond faster, reduce cost, and improve public safety.

### [Legion](https://legionintel.com/)

Legion is a secure, modular agent orchestration platform that unifies mission data and workflows, deployable across classified, air-gapped, and edge environments.

### [Method Platform](https://www.method.security/)

The Method Platform is composed of integrations (cloud, endpoint, identity/directory services, and vulnerability scanners), tools (network, vulnerability, web, OSINT scanning, and validation), guardrails (operator-in-the-loop and on-the-loop breakpoints and approval workflows for AI-generated plans), data management (transforming raw tool and integration data into linked knowledge across a cyber ontology), and AI agents (to recommend work or execute tasks end-to-end).

Together, these capabilities enable autonomous or semi-autonomous cyber operations across on-premises, cloud, and edge environments.

### [Oligo Runtime Security Platform](https://www.oligo.security/)

Oligo delivers runtime security for modern applications, cloud workloads, and AI systems. By analyzing application and infrastructure behavior in production, Oligo reveals what is actually running, identifies which vulnerabilities are truly exploitable, and detects malicious activity as it happens.

Unlike traditional security tools that rely on static scanning or passive visibility, Oligo focuses on runtime behavior to detect real attacks and surgically block them at the first exploit attempt. This precision helps security teams cut through alert noise, protect critical systems from both known and unknown threats, and focus on the signals that matter most: what happens at runtime.

### [Picogrid Legion](https://www.picogrid.com/)

Legion is a cloud-native software built to provide platform-agnostic infrastructure for command and control capabilities.

### [Skydio Federal Cloud](https://www.skydio.com/)

Skydio Federal Cloud is a software-as-a-service application used to manage and conduct unmanned aircraft operations. The system provides capabilities to organize users and roles, register and manage drones, and configure operational settings for flight activities. Operators use the system to plan and initiate drone flights, monitor flight status, view live and recorded video, and capture and review flight-associated data products.

The system also provides historical records and audit-relevant information associated with user activity, device activity, and flight execution.

### [SmartPM](https://www.smartpm.com/)

SmartPM is a cloud-native schedule analytics and risk intelligence platform purpose-built for the construction industry. It ingests raw scheduling data (.xer, .mpp, .xml, .ppx, .pp) and applies critical path method (CPM) logic, delay analysis frameworks, and earned value methodologies to surface risks, measure progress, and automate forensic-level oversight.

SmartPM supports international standards in scheduling and delay analysis, offering defensible insights for audit, compliance, and performance monitoring of capital projects.

### [SpecterOps BloodHound Enterprise](https://specterops.io/)

See your organization from the attacker's view. BloodHound Enterprise is an Attack Path Management solution that continuously maps and quantifies identity Attack Paths in Active Directory and Azure.

### [Streamline](https://www.valinor.co/)

Streamline is the first third-party product deployable through Palantir Foundry, offering secure, offline-capable mobile data collection integrated with Foundry's infrastructure and ontology, enabling non-technical users to easily create and manage authenticated or public data intake tools.

### [Unstructured Platform](https://unstructured.io/)

The Unstructured Platform is an enterprise-grade ETL solution that automatically transforms complex, unstructured data into clean, structured data for GenAI applications.

### [Valinor Harbor](https://www.valinor.co/)

HarborOS is a secure, modular software platform designed to enable distributed medical operations and data management in austere or disconnected environments. It integrates infrastructure monitoring, patient tracking, and logistics coordination within a FedRAMP-compliant cloud architecture to support Harbor Box facilities.

**Trimble** is delivering a Software as a Service (SaaS) cloud computing environment built within a secure Government Community Cloud. Designed specifically for U.S. Federal Government departments, agencies, and defense/civilian contractors, Trimble Connect for Government provides a unified, highly secure ecosystem for managing infrastructure, spatial data, capital projects, permitting, and facility assets across their entire lifecycle.

By establishing a FedRAMP Moderate baseline, Trimble enables federal agencies and DoD contractors to comply with federal security mandates (including CMMC alignment for defense projects) while modernizing digital engineering, field operations, and spatial asset management.

### Key Modular Packages Included in Scope

1. **Trimble Field Collaboration**
   * **Target Audience:** Federal agencies requiring highly secure, air-gapped capable spatial data management.
   * **Core Functionality:** Provides foundational spatial database infrastructure and GIS integration to support field operations, mapping, and mission-critical asset location tracking in high-security environments.

2. **Trimble Project Management**
   * **Target Audience:** Contractors and agencies needing precision field data layout and project management for high-compliance defense and civil construction builds.
   * **Core Functionality:** Connects design-to-build workflows in the field, facilitating high-accuracy layout, project tracking, collaboration, and quality assurance across DoD and federal civil construction sites.

3. **Trimble Asset Management**
   * **Target Audience:** Federal agencies managing extensive facility networks, military bases, and transportation infrastructure (e.g., runway distributions, airfield facilities, roads and utilities).
   * **Core Functionality:** Serves as a centralized facilities data core to map asset distribution, track condition assessments, streamline maintenance workflows, and optimize lifecycle capital planning.

4. **Trimble Permit Management**
   * **Target Audience:** Public lands, defense, and civilian agencies managing land use, licensing, and infrastructure rights-of-way.
   * **Core Functionality:** Streamlines the end-to-end management of permitting, licensing, land use applications, and right-of-way approvals in a compliant, audit-ready cloud environment.

Fulcrum is a cloud manufacturing operations system for small and mid-sized discrete manufacturers, including CNC machine shops, sheet metal fabricators, and aerospace and defense suppliers. It combines ERP, MRP and manufacturing execution in one web application, from quoting and planning through scheduling, shop-floor tracking, quality, shipping and invoicing.

Archie, the AI built into Fulcrum, answers questions about a customer's live shop data, takes actions on it, and builds custom pages and tools. Customers can also connect their own AI assistants to the same data tools through the Fulcrum MCP server, within each user's permissions. Archie's AI models are hosted in Microsoft Azure Government with the rest of the offering, so prompts to Archie and the shop data it reads stay in Azure Government; a customer's own assistant runs wherever the customer chooses.

Customers reach the service through a web browser, a REST API and MCP.

serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
The Akamai Content Delivery Network provides an 100% available platform to improve the performance and customer experience of your web content while providing robust security protections for your infrastructure – all at the edge of the internet and at an unmatched global scale.  Akamai’s solutions are configured through the Akamai Control Center customer portal or via APIs to automate your workflows. Akamai Intelligent Platform infrastructure solutions included in the JAB authorized boundary are:
Security - WAAP, WAF, WEP Web Application and API protections powered by an adaptive security engine (ASE) help protect from a wide range of network and application-layer threats with less effort and overhead. This solution is built on our Intelligent Edge Platform and comes prebuilt with performance capabilities that are designed to ensure your websites, web applications, and APIs perform their very best. Cloud-based web application firewall (WAF) — which harnesses visibility across the platform to stop the most sophisticated denial-of-service (DoS), web application, and API-based attacks.
Secure Content Delivery Network - for HTTP and HTTPS for delivering secure, high performing and highly available web applications and APIs at scale.  
Edge enterprise DNS Protection (with DNSSEC) and Global Traffic Management - designed so that Internet users can more reliably get to your websites or any other IP application. It applies an Internet-centric approach to global load balancing to provide high site availability and responsiveness to online user requests. 
NetStorage - Cloud Storage, cloud-based service designed to meet storage requirements while offering customers cost reduction and a simplified management effort. Globally distributed cloud-based storage that maximizes delivery and performance.
Media Services Live - Media streaming services - enabling agencies to stream and provide content to their viewers. Providing a consistent, high-quality viewing experience across the broad variety of network types — fixed or mobile — at varying connection speeds, globally.

Akamai Enterprise Application Access (EAA) is a Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solution that provides secure, identity-aware access to private applications without the need for a VPN. By closing all inbound firewall ports and integrating with existing identity providers, EAA ensures that only authorized users can access specific applications, significantly reducing the attack surface.

Oracle Federal Managed Cloud Services provides hosting, applications management, infrastructure support, and operation and maintenance (O&M) services to U.S. federal government agencies. Primary services include hardware and facilities setup/configuration, application management, testing, monitoring, patching, incident management, problem resolution, technical and functional service desk, point upgrades, security, and disaster recovery.

The FMCS Infrastructure information system resides in a physically and logically isolated Federal Government Zone within the general security perimeter of Oracle's U.S. Data Centers. The environment has been architected following FISMA and NIST guidance to help Federal customers achieve and maintain Authority To Operate (accreditation) for their relevant information systems or data hosted at Oracle.

Government Community Cloud (GCC) is a ServiceNow cloud service offering that delivers the Now Platform in an environment that complies with stringent cloud security and privacy compliance requirements defined by the United States Federal Government. New Relic is the intelligent observability platform, providing complete visibility across your complex IT environment (both on-prem and in the cloud). Our SaaS solution is a unified data platform that ingests and analyzes a wide array of telemetry data—metrics, events, logs, and traces. This provides a single source of truth for monitoring the performance of applications, infrastructure, and user experiences. Our platform empowers your teams to see, understand, and act on real-time telemetry data from every application, service, and piece of infrastructure.

Appian Government Cloud (AGC) Moderate provides Appian’s process automation platform for moderate-impact workloads. AGC offers Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) functionality, which empowers agencies to design, automate, and optimize their operations to increase efficiency and productivity. It's an ideal solution for government agencies looking to streamline processes, particularly in the areas of critical acquisitions, case management, and logistics. Any agency can use Appian to orchestrate and automate complex processes to improve its performance and better serve constituent needs.

Rackspace Government Cloud (RGC) is purpose-built to help organizations achieve Assessment & Authorization faster and with cost savings of up to 70%. Whether you are a government agency, systems integrator, or independent software vendor, RGC is the foundation you need to rapidly deliver mission value via the cloud.

serviceIdentification.serviceName: Economic Systems Federal Human Resources Navigator
serviceIdentification.serviceAcronym: Economic Systems Federal Human Resources Navigator
serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: FedHR Navigator provides U.S. Federal agencies with human resources (HR) tools and utilities that are tailored to the needs and requirements of the U.S. Federal government. FedHR Navigator is available to agency customers as a subscription and allows for agencies to choose what parts of the application to purchase. The application allows users to create forms and cases and route them through the agency's business process. The application also features specialized tools to support Federal HR including our retirement benefits calculator, PD+, our position management repository, and supports integrations with Federal government systems. FedHR Navigator supports talent acquisition, position management and classification, performance management, awards, personnel actions, benefits, retirement, separation, employee and labor relations, and workforce planning. FedHR also features specialized reporting and data visualization for Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Accessibility.

IBM Platform Services provides core services for managing devices, applications, content, identity & access management, end-to-end visibility, dynamic resource allocation, and improved operational risk and resiliency. These services work together to modernize device management, IAM, observability, application resource monitoring, and providing clients with AI-driven recommendations and tips that are prioritized and customized for your applications. 

IBM MaaS360 for Government is a comprehensive, cloud-based unified endpoint management and security platform for devices, applications and content built on a secure multi-tenant architecture. Government agencies use MaaS360 to protect data and optimize productivity, enabling employees to work anytime and anywhere through trusted mobile interactions. MaaS360 offers device management and security without the added costs and complexities of deploying hardware and software, dealing with intricate configurations, and dedicating additional resources to support the solution on an ongoing basis. MaaS360 allows administrators to manage and enable security on smartphones, tablets and laptops and increase end users’ productivity by enabling secure access to their enterprise data on their endpoint devices. 

IBM Verify for Government is an Identity-as-a-Service (IDaaS) platform enabling organizations to secure and modernize experiences for workforce and citizens. IBM Verify provides modern Single-sign-on (SSO) using standard protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth, etc.), supports legacy protocols and access to thousands of popular cloud service applications, and in-house applications, with hundreds of pre-built templates for faster integration. IBM Verify manages the lifecycle of users and groups through a scalable and elastic directory, provides granular, attribute-based policies, and supports multi-factor authentication. Government agencies can provide a digital first experience for secure and frictionless authentication for citizens. 

IBM Instana for Government is a leading full-stack observability tool that automatically and continuously delivers the highest-fidelity data in one-second granularity, with end-to-end distributed tracing of every call or request, and provides a graphing model with dynamic maps to show you how everything is related. IBM Instana for Government allows you to see the exact data you want in the context you need to quickly determine the cause of an issue and take immediate action to fix it. Government agencies can monitor their entire stack with end-to-end visibility across shared services and gain real-time contextual understanding to find and fix problems faster.

IBM Turbonomic for Government is the leading Application Resource Management (ARM) solution that dynamically allocates resources in real-time boosting efficiency, minimizing cloud expense, and preventing downtime. IBM Turbonomic for Government delivers continuously optimized application resource performance across hybrid multi-cloud environments providing intelligence automation and proactive resource management that scales existing resources efficiently; preemptive analytics to help maximize resource utilization; dynamic resource allocation; and seamless integration across on premises, public, private, hybrid and multiple cloud domains.

IBM Concert for Government is the connective tissue that harmonizes data from disparate tools and environments, transforming it into actionable knowledge aimed at improving operational risk and resiliency and freeing up teams to focus more on innovation. IBM Concert for Government provides AI-driven recommendations and tips that are prioritized and customized for your applications. Get automated data analysis from disparate systems and tools, identify operational issues before they escalate, increase efficiency with Concert’s recommendations and automation of repetitive tasks. Government agencies can uncover crucial insights about their operations and get application-specific recommendations for improvement.

The Tyler Federal Product Suite (formerly MicroPact Product Suite), which includes icomplaints® and entellitrak®, is delivered via a Software as a Service (SaaS) and a Platform as a Service (PaaS) model to U.S. federal, state, and local government customers. Icomplaints is the leading standard for federal EEO case management and is used by most major federal agencies. Entellitrak, which takes a Data-First™ approach to dynamic case management and Business Process Management (BPM), is available with fully integrated Document Management, Natural Language Analytics, and Mobile Modules. Whether based on-premises or in the cloud, entellitrak can be implemented immediately and configured continuously, enabling customers to get to work quickly while keeping costs low. Tyler Federal is unique as a developer of commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) case management and BPM software in that 97 percent of all federal agencies with more than 500 employees currently use one or more solution from the Tyler Federal Product Suite.

The Microsoft Azure Commercial Cloud exports savings to the customer by delivering the software, platform, and information technology infrastructure resources where and when it is needed via the Internet. 

Microsoft Azure Commercial Cloud is used for building, deploying, and managing applications and services through a network of Microsoft-managed data centers. It provides Software as a Service (SaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and supports many different programming languages, tools, and frameworks, including both Microsoft-specific and third-party software and systems. The advantages of using Microsoft Azure Commercial Cloud include the ability to build large scalable applications serving large populations of users by scaling up or scaling down in relatively short periods of time.

The Oracle Service Cloud is Oracle's premier Software as a Service (SaaS) solution providing the industry's best in class customer service platform for enterprise customers. Oracle Service Cloud is deployed onto a robust, secure infrastructure hosting Oracle's patented CX software applications in an environment accredited to FedRAMP-Moderate specifications. The Oracle Service Cloud leverages a fault-tolerant core application framework offering flexible add-on modules providing customers with a customizable, out-of-the-box feature set to support both customer-facing and customer service agent-facing functions. The Oracle Service Cloud is offered as a hosted cloud solution (i.e., operated and maintained by Oracle within its secure hosting environment at co-location facilities in the United States) providing customers with a modern, efficient and secure cloud solution via a proven Software as a Service (SaaS) delivery model.

IBM Cloud for Government is a high performance, high security Cloud, providing both Infrastructure and Platform Cloud Services. IBM Cloud for Government delivers seamless integrated computing environments across multiple data centers. IBM integrates and automates infrastructure and platform services empowering federal agencies with complete control, security, scalability and ease-of-management via an Agency Portal and Secure Open API. The Agency portal and API provide administrators and developers with direct access to more than 100 backend systems, services and activities. IBM Cloud for Government is designed for optimized network management, various performance levels and enhanced security. It provides automated provisioning of services in public, private, and hybrid cloud offerings with quick and easy access to developer tools. The USDA's Digital Infrastructure Services Center (DISC) is a federally-owned Cloud Service Provider for systems that are owned by Federal, State, and Local governments. The USDA DISC offers both IaaS and PaaS services to its customers on Midrange and Mainframe infrastructure, with a variety of operating system platforms and database options to choose from in a fully virtualized hosting environment. Network services are provided for both IaaS and PaaS environments, and offer robust, secure and highly redundant connectivity to the USDA WAN and the Internet. Additional information about these services is available here (http://www.ocio.usda.gov/about-ocio/data-center-operations-dco).

The USDA DISC Service Catalog is available here (http://www.ocio.usda.gov/document/nitc-service-catalog)

The USDA DISC Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) offering provides a virtual machine infrastructure which allows customers the option to maintain control of their operating and general support systems at the system level. Network, Facility and Operational Support Services are included with all IaaS offerings. Security monitoring and defense in depth for all IaaS servers is provided via periodic vulnerability scanning with best-in-class software. IaaS customers receive the benefit of fully managed standardized hardware, advanced server virtualization, strict standards, security and economies of scale from DISC.

The USDA DISC's Platform as a Service (PaaS) offerings build upon IaaS offerings and enable customers to select from secure, standardized Operating System images that are configured to meet actual processing requirements. The PaaS service offering provides fully managed Operating Systems that are maintained by USDA DISC. These hardened and virtualized operating systems leverage advanced server virtualization technologies, compliant security and build standards, and economies of scale. The PaaS offering enables rapid delivery of cost-effective, fully-managed operating platforms offering expanded controls to securely host customer's mission critical applications. This USDA DISC PaaS offering is currently available for multiple operating systems, including: RedHat Linux, Microsoft Windows, Oracle Solaris, IBM AIX, and zOS. The DISC PaaS Service offering also fully supports many database offerings, including: mySQL, MSSQL, Oracle and DB2.

Security services offered by USDA DISC, as part of all standard service offerings, are implemented and monitored through Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM) solutions.
In addition to the FedRAMP Moderate security control baseline, the USDA DISC has implemented FISMA High security controls for all service offerings and FedRAMP+ DoD Impact Level 4 (IL4) controls within the Midrange PaaS service offering.

These cloud-based services are designed to provide organizations with streamlined communication, high availability, comprehensive security, and simplified information technology (IT) management. M365 GCC provides the interactivity of on-premises client and server applications with the flexibility and scalability of web-based services. M365 GCC leverages Azure Government as the IaaS/PaaS for the underlying infrastructure and hardware. Therefore, M365 GCC relies on Azure Government-inherited services. The Maximus Intelligent Virtual Assistant (MIVA) is a turn-key FedRAMP-authorized SaaS solution that replaces traditional touchtone and directed dialog speech IVRs at the front-end of contact centers. MIVA uses a combination of artificial intelligence (AI) and human understanding to interact conversationally with callers.

 

MIVA applications are built to support government-specific requirements, including status updates for applications and accounts, call routing, and FAQs.  Callers can receive self-service information via voice, email, and text messages. MIVA integrates will all major call routing and telephony systems, and major carrier networks.

Xerox Managed Print and Capture Services (MPCS) for US Government is a cloud-based solution developed specifically to help US Federal, State, and Local government agencies manage the print and document capture life cycles within an organization while maximizing productivity, security and reducing waste and risk.

The Xerox Managed Print Services (MPS) capability is a management solution for both Xerox and Non-Xerox print/imaging devices such as printers, multi-function devices, and copiers. Managed print services focus on the management of print output devices themselves, related supplies, and service requirements. The solution ensures proactive device management resulting in maximum uptime, utilization/optimization, and robust print and security policy management.

Xerox Capture Services provide advanced multichannel capture, digitization, and data transformation to help government agencies achieve digital transformation goals. Digitization and imaging services can be provided on-site, near-site or off-site.  Digitization can be combined with data transformation, process automation, and electronic document management solutions to ensure optimal speed and productivity. 

Xerox Connect for Microsoft OneDrive FedRAMP Authorized and Microsoft 365 FedRAMP Authorized apps are developed specifically to help US Federal, State, and Local government agencies securely connect their Xerox ConnectKey Enabled multi-function devices to the Microsoft Government Community Cloud Environment (GCC). These apps will allow users to choose scan or print workflows, navigate directly to their file or folder, and convert to popular Microsoft Office formats directly from the User Interface of the device.

Acquia provides the leading cloud platform for building, delivering, and optimizing digital experiences.

Acquia is the enterprise platform behind Drupal, the leading open-source content management system, recognized as a Magic Quadrant Leader by Gartner two years in a row. Our platform enables agencies to foster greater digital engagement with citizens and securely deliver mission essential information and services with greater speed, agility, and resiliency.

The City of LA, State of New York, FEMA, Department of Homeland Security and many other government agencies rely on the Acquia platform to build websites and digital experiences that meet the needs of their citizens, internal users and IT teams while moving their missions forward. These agencies know that a citizen-centric government requires more than simply taking the existing physical structure and making it digital. Today the term "digital" has taken on a new meaning. In the private sector, consumers can shop, pay bills, and even conduct banking online, and now they're expecting to conduct government business online in the same way. The most forward-thinking government IT managers are finding ways to meet expectations set by the private sector, and then going above and beyond to serve citizens.
With the Acquia Platform governments and agencies can use limited taxpayer dollars efficiently to build sites and experience that meet the needs of IT, deliver on the mission and give citizens crucial information they need.

serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: The Tyler Data Platform, powered by Socrata®, which includes Enterprise Data Platform and Open Data Platform, is the market leader in making government data discoverable, usable, and actionable for government workers and the people they serve. Tyler Data & Insights provides the data platform and cloud applications exclusively for city, county, state, and federal government organizations. Government programs generate massive amounts of data, but most of it is locked away in hard-to-access data silos. The Tyler Data Platform provides enterprise-wide data management for government analytics by bringing together disparate systems and leveraging the cloud to enable secure access to authoritative data. Tyler Data & Insights solutions are designed and developed to meet strict government compliance standards. The technology is optimized on the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.

Accenture Federal Cloud ERP is a secure cloud offering delivering virtualized back-office ERP solutions, covering Financial Management, Property/Asset Management, HR and Payroll, to US federal customers. Accenture leverages Oracle applications (E-Business Suite, PeopleSoft, OBIEE, Hyperion) and other COTS applications (Sunflower), cloud technology and assets from 20+ years of experience to help customers to meet their unique mission requirements.

Cloud.gov is designed and operated by US government workers, for US government work. Cloud.gov reduces the barriers to rapid, incremental, compliant, secure, and scalable delivery of government services by all government agencies, leveraging best-of-breed modern practices. Cloud.gov provides a Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) based on Cloud Foundry, enabling instant provisioning of services and environments, easy deployment of applications, and rapid scaling to match demand. Cloud.gov includes tools to quickly incorporate 800-53 NIST control documentation into easily-prepared and comprehensive System Security Plans (SSPs) for evaluation by local agency information security organizations or FedRAMP, reducing the time it takes for teams to gain Authority To Operate (ATO).

serviceIdentification.serviceName: Huddle Enterprise Cloud Content Collaboration and File Sharing Portal for Government
serviceIdentification.serviceAcronym: Huddle Enterprise Cloud Content Collaboration and File Sharing Portal for Government
serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Huddle provides the most secure, easy-to-use, and tightly integrated workspaces for government agencies to collaborate with each other and contractors. Its zero-trust architecture provides a highly controlled environment that is fully auditable for data governance and compliance.
- Total control over who can access, view, and edit workspaces and documents.
- Integrations with Microsoft Office ensure a seamless experience.
- Fully auditable workspaces with trackable tasks and assignments.
- Supports stringent security and risk mitigation strategies.

Maximus Cloud is a FedRAMP Authorized multi-tenant Private and Government Community Hybrid Cloud designed exclusively for use by government customers only. Built to meet government compliance and security requirements, our managed Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS), Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS), and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) portfolio of solutions are hosted, managed, secured, and monitored to provide the highest scalability, reliability, and availability of mission-critical systems and services. Our FedRAMP Authorized services include: 

•	Maximus Amazon Connect Platform (MACP): Enterprise-class omnichannel cloud contact center solution. 
The Engagement Platform leverages Amazon Connect technology to provide an optimized citizen engagement experience that enables citizens to communicate with your agency across all channels – including voice, email, SMS and web chat. The Amazon Connect Platform also provides key additional modular features such as workforce management, recording and quality management, analytics, AI and a robust reporting framework.
•	Maximus Enhanced Reporting (SKPI): Solution providing insights to customer service
Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) Total Customer Experience solution powered by SuccessKPI that uses AI and machine learning to provide key insights on customer service experiences over text and audio. The platform uses speech recognition and natural language understanding (NLU) to analyze conversations between customers and agents in real-time. With omni-channel capabilities, SuccessKPI brings together information from every customer point of contact to provide comprehensive datasets for improving the consumer experience. 
•	Maximus Robotic Procedure Automation (RPA): Solution to automated tasks
Platform-as-a-Service (Paas) solution powered by Automation Anywhere that uses a web-based management system that uses a control room to run automated tasks that combines traditional Robotic Process Automation (RPA) with cognitive elements like Natural Language Processing (NLP), reading unstructured data, and machine learning capabilities.
•	Maximus Life X Improve Digital Testing (LXI): Solution to screen and reduce risk of individuals at risk of suicide
Powered by MindX Sciences is an easy-to-use tool that can identify individuals at risk for suicidality and provide personalized risk-reduction and life improvement strategies. Based on the Niculescu Convergent Functional Information for Suicidality Scale (CFI-S), the test does not ask about suicidal ideation, making it suitable for non-clinical settings such as large organizations or educational settings. The test's validity and reliability have been validated through published studies in scientific and medical journals. Additionally, clinicians can use the test for a nominal yearly fee to reduce suicide risk in their patient population, with a CPT code for clinical use available. Overall, the SX Prevent test is an innovative approach to suicide prevention that can support individuals at risk and may prove beneficial in various settings.
•	Maximus Digital Experience Hub (DXHub): Solution for hosting web applications and microservice based applications.
Enterprise-class platform for hosting web applications and microservice based applications.  DXHub is a cloud-native solution powered by kubernetes (EKS) running containerized workloads in either single or multi-tenant configurations.  DXHub has DevOps intrinsically built into it, allowing for the rapid and frequent rollout of incremental application code releases.  DXHub helps government deliver modern and fault tolerant applications to citizens by reducing their total cost of ownership; increasing the speed to production for application releases via reusable web application templates; the rapid delivery of enterprise application workloads. 
•	OpenText XMedius (Fax): Solution for receiving digital fax
OpenText XMedius is a fax solution. This increases the functionality for agencies looking to include fax communication with agency customers.
•	NexTalk TTY (TTY): Solution for handling TTY (teletypewriter)
NexTalk is a TTY solution. This increases the functionality for agencies looking to support the hearing impaired with agency customers.
•	Maximus CodeShuttle: 
Enterprise-class CI/CD pipeline automation platform. CodeShuttle is a cloud-native solution hosted on Kubernetes (EKS) that provides an open-source framework-as-a-service to automate build, test, and deploy pipelines across multiple cloud and on-premises environments. Built around an "Everything as Code" model, it delivers automated code quality checks, security scanning, multi-platform deployment support, configuration management, and artifact lifecycle management. The platform provides standardized CI/CD patterns with support for AWS and Azure, and assures products the capability to deploy solutions within federal boundaries.
•	Maximus Intelligent Document Processing (IDP): Solution to automate document image processing
IDP is a serverless, multi-tenant AWS SaaS solution that automates the extraction and processing of data from various document types. Key capabilities include:
AI-Powered Classification – leverages Amazon Bedrock with Claude AI for intelligent document categorization
Advanced Text Extraction – employs Amazon Textract for OCR of both printed and handwritten text
Multi-Language Support – processes documents in English and Spanish
Confidence-Based Routing – automatically routes low-confidence extractions to human review
Secure Multi-Tenancy – provides isolated processing storage for multiple agencies
RESTful API Integration – enables seamless integration with existing systems
Audit Trail Compliance – maintains comprehensive logging for regulatory requirements
Scalable Architecture – serverless design of processing components ensure automatic scaling based on demand
•	OneReach (ONR): Solution to use AI to automate tasks, build collaborative digital agents, and monitor customer experience.
A solution which includes:
Advanced Data Analytics: OneReach provides robust data analytics tools that help Maximus gain insights into service performance, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency. This enables data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement.
Automation and AI: With OneReach's automation and AI capabilities, Maximus can streamline processes, reduce manual tasks, and improve accuracy. This includes automating routine tasks, enhancing customer interactions with AI-driven chatbots, and optimizing workflows.
Cloud Integration: OneReach offers seamless cloud integration, allowing Maximus to leverage cloud-based solutions for scalability, flexibility, and cost-efficiency. This ensures that services can be accessed and managed from anywhere, enhancing accessibility and responsiveness.
Enhanced Security: OneReach provides advanced security features to protect sensitive data and ensure compliance with regulatory standards. This includes encryption, secure access controls, and continuous monitoring to safeguard information.
Customer Experience Management: OneReach's tools help Maximus improve customer experience by providing personalized and efficient service. This includes tracking customer interactions, analyzing feedback, and implementing improvements to enhance satisfaction.
Collaboration Tools: OneReach offers collaboration tools that facilitate communication and teamwork within Maximus. This includes project management software, communication platforms, and document sharing solutions to enhance productivity and coordination.
•	Kore.ai (Kore): Solution to use AI to automate Contact Center tasks, streamline work procedures, and other processes.
AI for Service
Automate and elevate customer interactions across voice and digital channels with solutions such as the Kore.ai Voice Gateway, Contact Center AI (CCAI), Agent Assist, Quality Management & Compliance, and Campaigns.
AI for Work
Enhance employee productivity and streamline workflows with AI Assistants, orchestration capabilities, and prebuilt agents for enterprise search, ITSM, HR, and recruitment.
AI for Process
Automate knowledge-intensive business tasks to improve compliance, reduce reliance on human experts, and ensure consistency at scale.
Agent Platform
A multi-agent orchestration infrastructure enabling enterprises to design, deploy, and manage sophisticated agentic applications. Businesses can customize agent autonomy — from guided to fully autonomous systems — to meet diverse needs.

DocuSign's features include authentication services, user identity management and workflow automation. The Federal Production Environment provides a complete message archiving solution that can protect an organization from legal liabilities and regulatory risks while improving email storage management and end-user productivity. Its web interface offers fully secure email archiving with robust search and discovery, supervision, and enforcement features. The solution securely stores electronic messages for a specified retention period, while keeping the messages fully searchable and retrievable in real-time or with a batch process. This allows archived messages to be easily viewed, retrieved to a user's email inbox or exported to an Outlook data file.

The Archiving Customer Premise Equipment (CPE) is software-based, a hardware-based version is also available, and is installed within the Microsoft Office 365 ITAR environment behind the firewall to provide the tight integration and security typically only afforded to internal systems. The CPE integrates with Microsoft Exchange to ensure reliable, native format message archiving. Its integration with Active Directory facilitates unified login and access control management. Since the CPE is the only holder of the encryption keys used with Proofpoint's DoubleBlind™ Encryption technology, any processing that involves encryption or decryption happens on the CPE.

Proofpoint's DoubleBlind™ Encryption technology guarantees the security of data, ensuring that no one outside the organization can access archived data. When a message reaches the CPE, it is encrypted before being sent outside the Microsoft Office 365 ITAR firewall over a secure connection to the Proofpoint Federal Production Environment. Messages are only decrypted when an authorized user on the customer network conducts a search from Outlook or from the CPE's web-based user interface. Data can never be viewed without access to both the archiving CPE within the Microsoft Office 365 ITAR environment and the Proofpoint Federal Production Environment.
