serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
ThreatLocker endpoint protection platform secures customer endpoints (laptops/desktops/servers) running Windows and MacOS using a policy driven deny-by-default approach. 
ThreatLocker's Allowlisting permits software, applications, and scripts to run only if they have been explicitly approved to run and blocks all others from running by default. 
ThreatLocker's Ringfencing enables organizations to control what applications are permitted to do whilst running, controlling, and limiting, applications' access to other applications, files, registry, and the internet. This stops legitimate and trusted applications being weaponized. 
ThreatLocker's Network Control is an endpoint firewall permitting only required and explicitly permitted network connectivity and connections and blocking all others by default. Network Control is also used to only allow specified protected devices to communicate with each other, by opening and closing ports dynamically. 
ThreatLocker's Storage Control offers granular control over both storage devices, such as USB's, and also locations. Data can be protected from exfiltration and damage by limiting which specific applications have access to it. 
ThreatLocker's Configuration Manager allows organizations to set configuration policies such as password complexity requirements disabling unneeded network protocols across an organization or set of organizations from one central location without the need to use group policies or active directory. 
ThreatLocker Detect uses the voluminous data in ThreatLocker logs and allows organizations to both alert themselves and respond automatically to anomalous events or suspicious behavior on their endpoints. In summary, the ThreatLocker zero-trust endpoint protection platform allows organizations to: 
• Block ransomware, viruses, malware, and rogue software from running. 
• Stop users from running unknown or unapproved software. 
• Stop lateral movement between applications and systems. 
• Stop trusted applications from being weaponized. 
• Control access to storage devices. 
• Audit and control data access by applications. 
• Quickly deploy and run an audit for the entire organization. 
• Update permissions quickly when requested and approved by IT. 
• Log and control all inbound network traffic. 
• Alert on and respond to defined anomalous events.

Wiz for U.S. Government

Wiz for U.S. Government (“Wiz for Gov”) is a cloud-native environment and product line that delivers a unified view of risk across a customer’s full cloud environment, from code to production. Wiz for Gov helps public sector agencies meet FedRAMP and FISMA compliance needs by focusing on the issues that matter most. The Wiz for Gov unified product line has three different components to secure your stack:


Wiz Cloud for Gov

Wiz Cloud focuses on assessing and prioritizing risk by analyzing vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, malware, identities, network paths, data, and AI risks. At its core is the Wiz Security Graph, which maps relationships between cloud resources to find "toxic combinations" that represent real risk. This approach automates risk assessments in alignment with OMB A-130's definition of risk as a function of the magnitude of harm and the likelihood of occurrence. It prioritizes these risks and routes them to relevant teams, providing a clear view of the attack path, blast radius, and recommended remediation steps.


Wiz Code for Gov

Wiz Code extends visibility into the development lifecycle to help enforce secure-by-design practices. By connecting directly to code repositories, Wiz provides full traceability from production issues back to the corresponding source code and owner. Wiz also integrates with CI/CD pipelines to enforce policies during image scanning and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) reviews, helping to identify risks earlier and accelerate time to production readiness. This shared view helps security and development teams collaborate, ensuring accountability and reducing mean time to remediation (MTTR).


Wiz Defend for Gov

Wiz Defend modernizes cloud threat detection and response by reducing alert fatigue and surfacing the root cause of issues faster. It leverages a cloud native runtime sensor, logs, and threat intelligence to identify malicious activity and enrich detected events with cloud context, providing SOC analysts with the information needed to assess threat impact and blast radius. This enhances active cyber defense across the full environment—including identity, workload runtime, network, data, and control plane components—and helps teams align response actions with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

Vantage for Government is an AI-powered OT/IoT cyber-resilience platform specifically designed to meet the security needs of federal agencies and critical infrastructure operators. It delivers unified asset visibility, threat detection and response, and risk management capabilities for OT, IoT and IT environments. 
 
1. Asset Visibility 
1.a. Asset Inventory: The platform combines passive, active and host-based data collection with AI-driven analysis and enrichment. This provides visibility across wired, wireless, and endpoint environments. Integrations with third-party systems and external files consolidate asset data into a single platform. 
1.b. Vulnerability and Exposure Management: The platform provides non-intrusive OT/IoT vulnerability detection with prioritized remediation recommendations based on exploitability and operational impact. 
 
2. Threat Detection and Response  
2.a. Threat Detection: The platform continuously monitors network and endpoint activity using built-in detection rules and OT/IoT-specific threat intelligence to detect ransomware, state-sponsored activity and hacktivist campaigns. AI-driven correlation reduces alert fatigue by delivering actionable, prioritized alerts. 
2.b. Process Anomaly Detection: The platform extracts commands and process telemetry through deep packet inspection of OT/IoT protocols. It establishes baselines and detects anomalies (including unknown threats) in process telemetry, control commands and device behavior. 
2.c. AI-Driven Remediation Recommendations: The AI engine correlates alerts and recommends mitigation actions based on operational context and defined workflows. 
2.d. Response Actions: The platform can automate response actions, such as enforcing network rules and isolating hosts, through integrations with SIEM, SOAR, firewalls and other SOC tools, or directly at the endpoint. 
2.e. Customizable Playbooks: User-defined playbooks and workflows standardize manual incident response across security and operations teams. They help teams share context and maintain timely communication. 
 
3. Risk Management & Compliance 
3.a. Measurable Risk: The platform provides customizable, multifactor risk scoring at the asset, zone, site and enterprise levels. Risk scores are assessed using asset inventory, network mapping, vulnerability detection, threat intelligence, and operational significance. 
3.b. Risk Mitigation: The platform supports risk mitigation through prioritized remediation recommendations based on operational impact and asset criticality. 
3.c. Compliance & Risk Monitoring: Dashboards with real-time risk trends, site-level accountability, industry benchmarks and compliance controls help teams communicate risk across the organization.

User account enrollment with role assignment.
Delegated approval
Account attributes management (account lifecycle).

Provisioning of new organization and user account attributes to Service Provider (applications).
Propagation of organization and user account changes to Service Provider (account lifecycle).

Customers of MAG can review user guides, including guides for the Organization Administrator which outline the secure configuration of the system, here: https://www.myexostar.com/knowledge-base/mag-training-resources/

Butterfly Ultrasound Probe System is the only ultrasound transducer that can perform “whole-body imaging” with a single handheld probe using semiconductor technology. Connected to a mobile phone or tablet, it is powered by Butterfly’s proprietary Ultrasound-on-Chip™ technology and harnesses the advantages of AI to deliver advanced imaging that is easy-to-use and improves patient outcomes.

The primary function of the Butterfly App is general-purpose diagnostic imaging, for use by qualified and trained healthcare professionals to enable the visualization and measurement of anatomical structures within the human body. The app is a free download from the Apple App Store or Google Play Store. The app and a vetted Butterfly account are required to use the Butterfly Ultrasound Probe System.

The Butterfly Cloud is hosted by Amazon Web Services (AWS) in multi availability zone fashion with cross-region data replication.

The development environment is where the initial software creation and code revision occurs. It's an area for developers to freely work on new updates without affecting the live application.

The staging environment, also known as the Quality Assurance (QA) environment, is the intermediary step where the software is tested in conditions that closely mirror the production environment. This is where thorough checks are conducted before any release.

The production environment is the live setting where the software is fully deployed for use by the end-users. It is the final and most stable environment, designed for uptime and reliability.

Butterfly Ultrasound Probe System offers two primary services: Public Cloud and Private or Enterprise Cloud:

Public Cloud: Designed for small groups, such as a team using the Butterfly web application, this service allows for the creation of an organization within the cloud. Team members can invite colleagues to join their organization. This multi-tenant approach enables different organizations, like those from various hospitals, to coexist simultaneously within the same public cloud infrastructure.

Private Cloud: An upgrade from the public cloud, this service provides a unique domain tailored for specific institutions, such as hospitals, which may establish separate organizations for each department. Like the public cloud, multi-tenant approach enables different organizations, like those from various hospitals, to coexist simultaneously within the same private cloud infrastructure.

The Butterfly Ultrasound Probe System uses industry standard third-party interconnections to provide robust and up to date security tools to protect the integrity of the Butterfly Ultrasound Probe System and related information.

An authorization boundary provides a diagrammatic illustration of a CSO’s internal services,
components, and other devices, along with connections to external services and systems.
Please note that external services include external cloud services that are not FedRAMP
Authorized, corporate shared services, and the external entities to which the system must
connect to receive updates for products installed within the system boundary.

An authorization boundary accounts for all federal information, data, and metadata that flow
through a CSO. If the CSO has strong configuration management and change management
built into the system development life cycle, the development environment can be outside the CSO boundary. This means that there is a 3PAO validated, reproducible and effective way to make service changes without impacting the production environment.

The authorization boundary diagram displays all in-scope system components for the Ironclad FedRAMP environment and is depicted with a prominent red border. All components outside of the authorization boundary are shown externally to the red border. The authorization boundary encompasses the Ironclad application and supporting infrastructure hosted entirely within GCP in the us-central1 region. All components depicted within the boundary directly support the operation, security, monitoring, and administration of the CLM system.

Within the authorization boundary, the FedRAMP environment consists of customer-facing
application services, internal application services, and data storage components deployed on GCP. Application components communicate with one another using Google-managed
networking services and all internal data flows are encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher. Data at rest within the authorization boundary is encrypted using customer-specific encryption keys and uses FIPS 140-2-validated cryptographic modules or higher where available.

Ingress and egress to the authorization boundary are controlled through a load balancer and
WAF that provide a single logical entry point for external connections. The WAF is configured to restrict and allow traffic based on approved ports, protocols, and services defined in the PPSM list. Network traffic entering or leaving the environment traverses these boundary protection mechanisms, and all external communications are encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.

Development and test environments are depicted and logically separated from the production environment. Access to development and test environments is restricted to authorized Ironclad personnel. Backup storage is provided through Google-managed backup services within the authorized environment and is depicted on the diagram. Backup data is encrypted at rest and in transit using FIPS-validated cryptographic modules.

CrestPoint Environmental Management Service (CEMS) Platform

Black Kite is delivered as a SaaS offering using a multi-tenant public cloud computing environment. It is available to the public, federal, state, local, and tribal governments, as well as research institutions, federal contractors, government contractors etc. Black Kite offers a separate configuration for federal/public sector customers to maintain the highest possible level of information security. Black Kite provides a defensive platform that spans the entirety of the third-party risk management life cycle for cyber risk professionals looking to quantify and maintain visibility of their risk exposure.
Black Kite’s core application, is a multi-user, transaction-based application suite that gives a three-dimensional risk picture of a company and its vendors through:
• A cyber risk technical assessment.
• A factor analysis of information risk (FAIR) analysis (the probable financial impact of a breach caused by a vendor).
• An external estimate of compliance (assessing that vendors have appropriate policies and processes in place).
• Executives get an easy-to-understand “Cyber Risk Report” with letter grade scores.
• IT security teams can drill down to the technical details behind each risk category.
• Risks/vulnerabilities are prioritized by severity so that security engineers can quickly identify critical issues and mitigate them.
• Industry benchmarks and comparisons are provided to help identify trends and pinpoint areas for improvement.
• Grading is based on industry standards and best practices (NIST, MITRE CVSS, FAIR, etc.)

CLEAR1 is CLEAR’s secure identity platform used to perform remote identity proofing for federal agencies and highly regulated environments. Identity is confirmed by correlating biometric signals, government-issued credentials, device attributes, and authoritative and credible evidence sources in real time.

CLEAR1 protects high-stakes workflows such as onboarding, account creation and recovery, and sensitive data access. The platform is policy-driven and aligned to the NIST Digital Identity Guidelines, including IAL2 and AAL2, and is approved by the Kantara Initiative as meeting these standards. Our comprehensive security program meets high standards for data protection and privacy, and is built to protect personal information and keep users in control. By verifying the person — not just the documents — CLEAR1 helps federal programs advance trust and protect their users at scale.

Everbridge Critical Event Management GovCloud is a suite of applications that empower the government community to detect, manage, and respond to critical events affecting personnel, facilities, and operations. The end-to-end platform integrates AI-assisted capabilities across applications such as mass notification and incident communication, real-time risk intelligence, geospatial common operating picture, crisis response management, and workflow automation to help agencies know earlier, respond faster, and improve continuously when managing threats and emergencies. 
 
Communications: 
Robust mass notification and incident communications capabilities enable personnel and stakeholders to share relevant information and situational awareness. This enables organizations to efficiently execute Emergency Mass Notification, Recall/Relocation, Personnel Accountability, Traveler and Lone Worker Safety, and targeted Emergency Response Team Coordination. The platform supports common alerting protocols and is capable of integrating with other alerting modalities.  Notification delivery is provided through multiple channels including:  text messages, emails, voice calls, mobile app notifications, desktop alerting.  It provides two-way communication capabilities enabling recipients to acknowledge receipt, confirm safety, request assistance, and/or receive location-specific information during emergencies. 

Visual Command Center: 
Visual Command Center (VCC) is the visualization and orchestration engine for Everbridge Critical Event Management GovCloud. VCC delivers a centralized common operating picture — integrating high fidelity contact, asset, and geospatial data — to enhance situational awareness and incident response. Through a single, unified view, organizations gain real-time threat intelligence and collaborative response capabilities, enabling them to mitigate or eliminate the impact of critical events on an unprecedented scale.

Risk Intelligence: 
The Everbridge Risk Intelligence Monitoring Center (RIMC) analyzes thousands of trustworthy, vetted, and hyper-local data sources – across over 100 risk categories – using machine-learning and AI technology, complemented by an experienced team of global risk analysts. Everbridge’s real-time alerting streamlines your organization’s ability to monitor and analyze worldwide events, dramatically increasing your ability to respond to risks that threaten your people, organization, supply chain. 

Response Management: 
Response Management digitizes response plans, shares documentation, tracks tasks and streamlines communications workflows for coordinated response efforts during crisis and other critical events. The platform supports collaborative decision-making and provides real-time status dashboards, situation reports (SITREPS) and after-action reporting (AAR) capabilities to provide full auditability and identify improvement opportunities for future events.

Everbridge Critical Event Management GovCloud is designed to be highly secure and scalable, supporting federal agencies in protecting personnel, maintaining operational continuity, and strengthening organizational resilience across diverse threat scenarios including natural disasters, IT/cybersecurity incidents, civil unrest, workplace safety events, and more.

Cyera for Government is an agentless, cloud-native SaaS data security platform.  Cyera for Government provides continuous visibility, AI-powered data classification, and protection for federal data across hybrid-cloud, SaaS, and on-premises environments. The system functions as a centralized data security control plane, enabling agencies to discover sensitive information, assess risk posture, and enforce security policies in real-time. By unifying Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) with advanced Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Artificial Intelligence Security Posture Management (AI-SPM), the platform provides the foundation for securing the federal AI lifecycle.
Cyera for Government enables the automated discovery and contextual classification of structured and unstructured data. It utilizes an AI-native classification engine to identify Federal Information, including Personally Identifiable Information (PII), Protected Health Information (PHI), and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI).
Beyond discovery, the platform delivers automated risk remediation and continuous monitoring to close security gaps before they are exploited. By analyzing data access patterns and permissions, Cyera identifies over-privileged users and "shadow data" that bypasses traditional controls. This proactive approach allows agencies to implement Zero Trust Data Access (ZTDA) architectures, ensuring that sensitive federal assets remain resilient against insider threats and external breaches.
Cyera for Government is specifically engineered to streamline regulatory compliance with federal mandates such as NIST 800-53, CMMC, HIPAA, and FISMA. The platform provides out-of-the-box reporting and audit trails that simplify the assessment and authorization process.

Wraithwatch is a Software-as-a-Service cybersecurity platform built on an intelligent security data fabric. The platform ingests data from across the customer's security and IT stack — endpoint detection and response, SIEM, identity providers, vulnerability scanners, cloud infrastructure, and more — through agentless, read-only API integrations. No agents are deployed on customer endpoints. Ingested data is normalized through deterministic entity resolution into a continuously updated entity graph that models every device, user, permission, vulnerability, configuration, and relationship in the environment. This unified data fabric eliminates tool-by-tool data silos and provides a persistent, queryable model of the customer's environment that powers all downstream platform capabilities.

Continuous Governance, Risk, and Compliance: Wraithwatch replaces periodic, point-in-time compliance assessments with continuous GRC that recomputes every few minutes and immediately upon auto-detection of environmental changes. The platform mathematically computes every viable attack path based on current topology, configurations, permissions, and verified reachability. When the environment changes — a new CVE, a granted permission, a configuration drift — the platform recomputes risks including second-, third-, and fourth-order cascading effects. Compliance posture, risk exposure, and control effectiveness are maintained as living measurements against the entity graph rather than static snapshots. Agencies can execute neutralization plans directly from Wraithwatch or deploy compensating detections where paths cannot be eliminated.

Threat Hunting: Autonomous reasoning workers explore SIEM indexes and security telemetry, identify anomalies and threat precursors, and surface findings with supporting evidence. Analysts issue natural language queries and the platform translates, hunts, pivots across data sources, and performs cross-index correlation at query runtime without requiring pre-mapped data schemas. Results convert into forward-looking detection rules.

Threat Advisory Correlation: Wraithwatch continuously correlates incoming threat intelligence — including newly published CVEs, active exploitation advisories, novel attack techniques, supply chain compromise reporting, and other non-CVE threat disclosures — against the current state of the entity graph. When a new threat is published, the platform automatically evaluates the customer's environment and produces an "am I affected" assessment identifying specific impacted assets, exposure conditions, and recommended mitigations. This analysis incorporates the full environmental context — network reachability, compensating controls, privilege relationships, and configuration state — to determine actual exploitability, not just the presence of a vulnerable component.

Control Plan Generation: Agency personnel describe a desired security outcome, and Wraithwatch evaluates every relevant setting across every integrated tool to generate a control plan. Plans are executable in full, one step at a time, or through phased rollouts with test groups. All actions are auditable with rollback support.

All adversarial analysis runs against the digital twin. No live exploits touch production infrastructure. The platform operates in read-only mode by default; write-mode actions require explicit customer authorization and human confirmation. Wraithwatch supports cloud-hosted deployment on FedRAMP-authorized infrastructure and fully on-premise deployment for air-gapped and CUI environments.

xAI’s Grok Enterprise for Government delivers frontier AI capabilities purpose-built for U.S. federal agencies, now available in a secure, compliant environment. Powered by the most advanced Grok family of models, it combines unmatched reasoning, real-time knowledge integration (including secure enterprise search), multi-agent collaboration, multimodal understanding (text, code, images, and video), massive context windows, and powerful API/agentic workflows.

ESChat for Government is a hardened version of the ESChat broadband communication, collaboration, and interoperability platform. ESChat is a Secure Broadband Push-to-Talk (PTT) communication system that facilitates secure inter-agency PTT communication, multimedia messaging, and a Common Operating Picture (COP) within and between agencies for mutual-aid or tactical purposes. ESChat for Government also supports external interfaces including Land Mobile Radio (LMR), dispatch consoles, and logging recorders

There are three main components that make up this offering:

- The ESChat portal is a browser-based application which allows customers to manage all aspects of their network including managing accounts, devices, groups, integrations,live and historical location display, etc.
- The ESChat clients are mobile applications (Android, iOS, Linux), Land Mobile Radio (LMR) gateways, and PC Client applications that communicate using the ESChat protocol. The ESChat clients are the functional endpoints that the users of the system interact with to perform Push-to-Talk voice and multimedia messaging communications with one another.
- The ESChat back-end services provide ESChat users with inter-carrier, inter-agency, inter-system, and inter-vendor interoperability all managed and controlled within the authorization boundary, ensuring ESChat is the only solution needed to provide reliable, secure, and interoperable communications.

ComplySyncATO is a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) automation platform designed to support continuous authorization and monitoring activities within cloud environments. The Cloud Service Offering (CSO) enables organizations to manage compliance posture through automated validation, evidence collection, and reporting aligned with FedRAMP 20x requirements.

ComplySyncATO integrates with cloud services to collect operational data and supports integration with external systems and service providers, enabling aggregation of compliance data and a unified view of compliance posture across multiple environments. The service is designed to support low to moderate impact systems and enables organizations to demonstrate continuous security compliance in machine-readable formats such as OSCAL, JSON, and XML, as well as human-readable formats.

The Adaptiva OneSite Platform enables its customers to autonomously manage the distribution of software and patches to endpoints across a customer’s enterprise, within the customer network, or across the Internet. The OneSite Platform consists of four primary components:
1)        A customer on-premises server operated and managed by customers that hosts an Adaptiva-developed OneSite application used to manage software distribution to the customer’s endpoints.
2)        A content delivery network (CDN) that enables customers to place software in the cloud for retrieval by managed customer endpoints across the Internet.
3)        Adaptiva Cloud Services Relay Servers that receive messages from a customer’s on-premises server and managed clients on the Internet. The relay servers facilitate communication between the customer server and the Internet-facing devices. 
4)        An Operations Manager (OpsMgr) server that is used by Adaptiva to manage OneSite cloud functionality and customer OneSite installation information.
The customer on-premises server provides functionality for the customer to manage the distribution of software to their endpoints. The server is owned and operated by the customer. Adaptiva support personnel do not have the ability to access or manage it. Software updates from Adaptiva are installed by the customer.
The Adaptiva OneSite Platform CDN is provided by Akamai, a FedRAMP-authorized Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) solution. The customer on-premises server running the OneSite application communicates with the CDN to upload the customer’s software that is in-turn accessed by the customer’s endpoints through commands conveyed by the relay server.
The relay server conveys command messages from a customer on-premises server to customer end points to direct the end points to download and install software. The relay server processes thousands of messages from on-premises servers to tens of thousands of customer endpoints. This server is hosted by DataBank, a FedRAMP-authorized IaaS and Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) provider.
An OpsMgr server is used for activating customer servers to be allowed to use relays for internet clients to obtain metadata and keys. The OpsMgr also receives and stores the messaging statistics for customer server and end points from relay servers. This OpsMgr server is hosted by DataBank.

Glytec’s Glucommander® is an FDA-cleared software-as-a-medical-device (SaMD), utilized for diabetes management and automated insulin titration. Glucommander is purpose-built to improve patient safety and clinical outcomes. Glucommander provides clinicians, hospitalists, and medical facilities with constant, data-driven dosing recommendations that stabilize blood glucose levels and decrease the incidences of hypoglycemia, length of stays and readmissions.

Midwatch is a secure enclave engineered for the protection of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI). It provides Federal Agencies and the Defense Industrial Base (DIB) with a secure environment to handle and share sensitive data requiring moderate security controls. Through the use of Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), Midwatch ensures strict logical separation between secure workloads and an organization’s broader enterprise information systems.

Midwatch enables secure, high-performance collaboration across several critical workflows, including:
Sensitive Data Collaboration: Secure co-authoring and collaboration on sensitive information and complex documentation stacks.
Advanced Engineering: Specialized support for CAD workflows and AI/ML GPU-accelerated workloads.
Software Engineering: Secure Software Development and DevSecOps via an integrated Gitflow platform, implemented in alignment with the Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF).
Operational Management: Integrated project management and secure task orchestration.
Remote Device Management: Midwatch ViPR provides a secure gateway between the VDI infrastructure and physical office or workshop floors, facilitating controlled and audited file transfers to engineering peripheral devices.

The Midwatch authorization boundary consists of a DevSecOps platform, VDI infrastructure, Midwatch ViPR remote access services, workflow automation, and vulnerability management tools, all hosted within a dedicated cloud organization. The environment is hardened through a segmented VPC architecture with Google Cloud Armor edge protection, the implementation of a Zero Trust Network Architecture (ZTNA) for all access requests, and robust data protection featuring centralized logging and Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK).

Midwatch is deployed as a government-community cloud within the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using US-only data centers. The system utilizes a microservices-based architecture powered by Docker and K3s/K8s/GKE Autopilot.

Pepelwerk provides a wide range of workforce and talent management services, including:

•        Access to internships and apprenticeships. 
•        Data-driven career decision tools.

For Organizations:

•        Community-driven data and predictive analytics.

Course matching for student enrollment and real-time training and skills development.

The highly configurable solution set includes multiple levels of continuous monitoring based on vendor risk levels, and point-in-time risk assessments to support procurement and M&A decision making.

Across these modules, AI-driven workflows accelerate each stage of the contracting lifecycle: Discover provides search and business development research tooling; Capture Cloud pinpoints relevant opportunities and guides solution architecture; Proposal Cloud automates compliance matrices, outlines, content drafting, and in-document graphics editing; Contract Cloud centralizes award data, CPARS, and status reporting; and the Data Library stores reusable credentials and documents. Together, these capabilities enable teams to find bids faster, craft higher-quality proposals with less manual effort, and maintain full visibility over contracts after award.

Magnet One delivers secure digital forensics and investigative analysis capabilities within a FedRAMP High authorized cloud environment, enabling U.S. federal agencies to ingest, process, analyze, and manage digital evidence in compliance with federal security requirements. The offering combines Magnet One’s advanced evidence review and collaboration features with a rigorously controlled architecture, documented security controls, and continuous monitoring aligned to FedRAMP standards, supporting mission operations while maintaining the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of sensitive federal data.

Halo is a multi-tenant cloud platform that provides a unified operating environment for service management, workflow automation, reporting, and compliance operations. The platform is designed to support organizations in managing operational processes, security workflows, and regulated service delivery from a single, integrated system.

For Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), Halo supports FedRAMP, CMMC, and DoD compliance programs by enabling compliance activities to be managed as part of day-to-day operations rather than as a separate workstream. Halo's GRC module provides functionality for vulnerability and risk management, Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) tracking, asset inventory, deviation management, OSCAL-based system documentation, and cross-framework control mapping. It also supports continuous monitoring packages, Key Security Indicator validation, and Ongoing Authorization deliverables in both human-readable and machine-readable formats.

In addition to GRC, the Halo platform supports broader enterprise service management capabilities, including IT Service Management (ITSM), Enterprise Service Management (ESM), Configuration Management (CMDB), and Service Level Management (SLM). These include core ITIL practices such as change management, incident management, user access management, self-service portals, automated task assignment and escalation, SLA tracking, and executive dashboards.

The Wallarm Federal Cloud (WFC) is a Software as a Service (SaaS) application programming interface (API) security platform that provides real-time traffic inspection and Web Application Firewall (WAF) capabilities for federal agencies. It is deployed in a single-tenant, Government-Only Cloud architecture on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Functionality and Use Case:
The system is designed to analyze incoming network traffic, mitigate malicious requests, and upload security metrics. The Wallarm Federal Cloud component processes this filtering node data, compiles custom security rules, builds API structure models, and provides the Wallarm Console user interface (UI) for configuration and security event investigation.1

Type of Federal Data:
The system is categorized at the Moderate security impact level. The federal data and information stored, processed, or transmitted includes:
- Full HTTP/HTTPS request and response bodies and headers for WAF analysis, which may contain customer API data.
- Security events, WAF rules, user profile and session data, and audit logs.
The system does not process, store, or transmit information requiring special protective measures beyond the standard FedRAMP Moderate baseline, such as Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI).

NinjaOne requires no infrastructure overhead, allowing agencies to modernize IT operations and shift resources from reactive tasks to mission-critical objectives. 

 
Key Components of the NinjaOne for Government platform include: 

- Endpoint management 

- Windows patching 

- Patching catalog 

- SSO 

- Remote access 

- Reporting

Verily Pre is an AI-native data platform purpose-built for precision health. Pre enables federal agencies, academic institutions, and commercial organizations to harmonize, govern, discover, explore, and analyze complex multimodal biomedical data – and to build and deploy AI models and agents directly into care and research workflows.

The platform includes  three integrated capabilities:
-  Refinery, a FHIR-native data curation engine that ingests and enriches siloed clinical and biomedical data into research- and AI-ready assets
- Exchange, a secure marketplace for discovering and sharing AI-ready datasets, models, and agents
- Workbench, a collaborative research environment with advanced cohort building, visualization, interactive analysis, batch workflow, and governance tooling.

The platform is built on infrastructure from multiple FedRAMP-authorized cloud providers and supports HIPAA compliance, role-based access controls, audit logging, and data use agreement enforcement.

Kovr AI is a patented AI-native cyber compliance automation platform purpose-built for organizations navigating the most demanding federal and commercial cybersecurity frameworks including FedRAMP, Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC 2.0), NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, DoD Security Requirements Guide (SRG), FISMA, DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF), PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, and more. Designed to replace the manual, document-heavy workflows that have historically made federal authorization a multi-year, multi-million-dollar undertaking, Kovr compresses the path from readiness to Authorization to Operate (ATO) by automating the most labor-intensive phases of the compliance lifecycle.
 
Kovr's AI-powered engine empowers users with evidence processing, control analysis, and artifact generation including System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), and Security Requirements Traceability Matrices (SRTMs) directly from system documentation inputs reducing artifact preparation time from weeks to days. The platform natively supports NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 and 800-171 control baselines, OSCAL-format exports, and continuous controls monitoring (CCM), enabling organizations to maintain their authorization posture between assessment cycles and satisfy evolving continuous monitoring requirements across FedRAMP Rev 5, CMMC, and DoD SRG frameworks.
 
Artemis, Kovr's secure AI enclave, allows ISSOs, compliance officers, and security teams to generate control implementation narratives, draft assessment responses, and accelerate evidence collection without exposing sensitive system data to external AI services. Pre-built connectors and automated evidence ingestion eliminate manual artifact management, while integrated POA&M lifecycle tracking provides real-time visibility into remediation status.

Patlytics is an AI-powered patent intelligence and intellectual property analytics SaaS platform that supports patent drafting, prior art and invalidity analysis, infringement detection, claim mapping, portfolio management, office action response support, litigation monitoring, and customer reporting.

Consus Gateway is delivered as a Software as a Service (SaaS) offering using a multi-tenant Government-Only Community Cloud computing environment. It is available to federal contractors and other organizations eligible to consume services hosted in AWS GovCloud (US), GCP Assured Workloads, and Azure Government. The CSO is an OpenAI-compatible AI model routing service: customer applications submit requests to a single API endpoint, and the gateway routes each request to the appropriate large-language-model (LLM) provider hosted within a FedRAMP-authorized cloud environment (AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, or Azure OpenAI Service). The system is designed with a zero-persistence architecture: prompt and response content are processed entirely in ephemeral AWS Lambda memory and are never written to disk, logged, or stored in any persistent data store. The only persistent records are operational metadata (request identifier, API key identifier, timestamp, model name, token counts, latency, source IP) used for billing, accountability, and continuous monitoring. The intended user base is United States federal agencies and US-person contractor organizations supporting federal missions.

TeamViewer helps IT teams deliver frictionless IT for employees and seamless IT operations for IT teams, transforming IT from a cost center into a strategic enabler. As a leader in the Digital Employee Experience (DEX) market, we provide a powerful end-user computing automation platform that enables organizations to lower service desk costs, maintain compliance, prevent user frustration, and improve the experience employees have with their devices and IT services. 

The platform is built on a client-server architecture hosted on Microsoft Azure Government. The Client service creates a secure, persistent connection with the DEX Platform service, enabling immediate outbound communication and real-time, device-generated, event-driven data delivery. A secondary communication channel, also initiated by the Client service, is used for large file transfers or non-urgent events such as inventory changes. 
 
Key Capabilities 
Experience Analytics 
Visualize and measure the end-user experience with continuous, real-time metrics across: 
•        Stability – Frequency of OS and application crashes, hangs, and service failures, often unreported but highly disruptive. Events are captured in real-time and can be linked directly to ITSM tickets. 
•        Responsiveness – Performance during normal operation, from OS startup speed to synthetic tests of system resources such as process creation, file operations, and registry access. 
•        Performance – Weighted load and throughput scores for CPU, memory, and disk resources. 

Employee Sentiment 
Capture real-time employee feedback on device performance, stability, and responsiveness through contextual surveys. Trigger follow-up actions when satisfaction scores are low. Send targeted notifications to employees about outages, maintenance windows, or important events. 

Endpoint Troubleshooting 
Remotely investigate and remediate device issues in real time—whether for a single device, a group, or the entire environment—reducing mean time to resolution (MTTR). 

Instruction Scheduling 
Extend Endpoint Troubleshooting by scheduling recurring instructions for ongoing maintenance or monitoring. 

Endpoint Automation 
Leverage real-time OS events to maintain baseline configurations, ensure critical services are always running, and prevent configuration drift. 

Content Distribution 
Optimize Microsoft Configuration Manager (ConfigMgr) software delivery and updates through peer-to-peer file sharing, reducing the need for on-premises Distribution Point servers and improving delivery speed. 

Inventory Insights 
Track hardware and software changes in real time. All events are normalized against a software catalog, giving IT a consolidated view of the environment and the ability to reduce software sprawl. 

Application Experience Management (AXM) 
Proactively monitor application performance at the endpoint. Real-time events provide visibility into application-level issues and version performance differences, enabling application owners to act quickly. 

Patch Insights 
Streamline patching cycles by identifying problematic devices or failed updates. Initiate patch deployment directly via ConfigMgr, WSUS, or Microsoft Update by triggering the Windows Update Agent. 

API Access 
Extend the DEX Platform with custom workflows and integrations into third-party systems such as ServiceNow to fit seamlessly into existing IT ecosystems.

Cisco Security Cloud for Government provides cloud-based security solutions with multiple component products.

 



Cisco Umbrella for Government 

Cisco Umbrella for Government delivers advanced, cloud-native cybersecurity, ensuring protection and compliance for government agencies to support their mission. It significantly uplevels government cybersecurity, offering comprehensive protection that meets the unique needs of government agencies. Cisco Umbrella for Government provides a comprehensive security suite with DNS-layer security and Secure Internet Gateway (SIG) capabilities, such as secure web gateway (SWG) , cloud-delivered firewall and intrusion prevention (Snort IPS), cloud access security broker (CASB), and data loss prevention (DLP), and integration with CISA Protective DNS. The feature set is comparable to the Cisco Umbrella product in use by over 30,000 Enterprise customers. Cisco Secure Access for Government includes more robust SSE capabilities than Cisco Umbrella for Government. Agencies looking for ZTNA and a high-performance architecture should choose Secure Access for Government.

 



Cisco Secure Access for Government

Cisco Secure Access for Government is a comprehensive Security Service Edge solution grounded in Zero Trust, that empowers Federal, State, and Local agencies to secure their workforce and data, simplify operations, and advance their mission with confidence. Its adaptive security capabilities, powered by Cisco Talos and AI, enable real-time threat detection, behavioral analysis, and predictive defense—ensuring proactive protection of your people and data against evolving cyber risks. With a comprehensive zero trust approach and a unique unified client, users gain seamless, secure access to critical applications across devices and locations—without compromising usability or performance. When paired with Catalyst® SD-WAN, Cisco Secure Access for Government delivers a holistic SASE solution. Enhanced integration with Catalyst SD-WAN will be available in 2026.

Key capabilities include:

A single platform for IT teams that centralizes management, streamlines policy enforcement, and reduces overhead. AI-driven automation accelerates response times and reduces human error, which integrates with  solutions like Duo and Cisco SD-WAN will enable a compliant, Zero Trust architecture tailored for public sector needs.
Cloud-native and continuously updated, Cisco Secure Access removes hardware complexity and scales effortlessly to meet the demands of dynamic government environments. The result: stronger security, improved user experience, and simplified operations—all built to protect the mission and serve the public. 
Secure Access for Government includes the following: Secure Internet Access (SIA) and Secure Private Access (SPA). Both products have Essentials and Advantage SKUs.
Offers robust protection against modern-day cyber threats through Zero Trust Network Access, DNS security, Secure Web Gateway (SWG), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Cloud-Delivered Firewall (FWaaS), Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), VPN as-a-Service (VPNaaS), Advanced Malware Protection, and Talos® Threat Intelligence capabilities.
Extends DNS security with an Integration with the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA’s) Protective DNS (PDNS).
 



Cisco Security Cloud Control

Cisco Security Cloud Control is a security platform that allows you to manage your security products and achieve security outcomes from a single integrated interface. Integrating security products in the platform is a streamlined experience. Within Security Cloud Control, user and group management occurs at the platform level. Roles are assigned to these users and groups to define their privileges for administering Security Cloud Control and the integrated products. Navigation between products and tools is intuitive and standardized with a common platform menu and toolbar for all integrated products.




Cisco Security Cloud Control - Firewall Management for Government 

Cisco Security Cloud Control - Firewall Management for Government delivers cloud-native firewall policy and device management through a unified management plane accessible through an intuitive web-based console. It enables centralized, scalable, and secure orchestration of Cisco next-generation firewalls (NGFWs) — including ASA and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) devices — across hybrid, cloud, and on-premises environments. With real-time visibility into traffic and threats, automated policy and object updates, and zero-touch provisioning for remote deployments - Security Cloud Control Firewall Management for Government reduces operational complexity for IT teams while strengthening cyber resilience and enabling secure modernization across mission-critical infrastructure. This product will now also include AIOps features like Policy Analyzer & Optimizer, Feature adoption, and a summary dashboard for customers to ensuring faster and accurate anomaly detection using Artificial Intelligence. A SAL Eventing License Utilization Dashboard will also be available to the customers.

 



Cisco Multicloud Defense for Government 

Cisco Multicloud Defense for Government is designed to provide consistent, automated protection across multicloud environments, including AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI. It integrates network security with multicloud networking, offering multi-directional protection to stop inbound attacks, prevent lateral movement, and block data exfiltration. With its centralized SaaS control plane, Cisco Multicloud Defense simplifies security management, enabling organizations to create and enforce unified security policies across all cloud environments in real-time. By leveraging advanced features such as dynamic policy management, continuous asset discovery, and automation, Cisco Multicloud Defense empowers organizations to reduce complexity, enhance operational efficiency, and maintain robust security across their multi-cloud infrastructure.

 



Cisco Secure Email Threat Defense for Government

Cisco Secure Email Threat Defense for Government exemplifies our ongoing commitment to delivering trusted, government-grade email security for agencies, contractors, and organizations handling regulated or sensitive data. Secure Email Threat Defense, a cloud-scale advanced email security layer, harnesses AI powered detections to provide comprehensive protection against advanced email threats, integrated as an API-based supplemental control or with the addition of new pre-delivery inline gateway protection.

Beyond the governance and compliance benefits, Cisco Secure Email Threat Defense for Government delivers a set of advanced protection capabilities that align directly with real-world email threat risks — especially for organizations that are particularly sensitive to BEC, phishing, QR Code/Quishing Detection, brand impersonation, or high-risk personnel.

 



Duo Federal

Duo’s Federal Editions can verify the identity of users with secure and easy to use two-factor authentication methods that helps public sector entities satisfy NIST 800-63-3 and 53/63/171 authentication requirements. In addition to verifying users’ identities, Duo’s solution checks the security health of every device authenticating into the environment, at the time of access. Admins can use Duo to enforce stricter device and application access policies, such as blocking login requests based on location or anonymous networks. Duo ensures only trusted users and devices can access protected applications. This complete security solution prevents modern attackers that often target multiple areas - including credential theft and the exploitation of known software vulnerabilities affecting outdated software versions.

Anecdotes is an Agentic GRC platform that delivers continuous compliance for enterprises managing GRC at scale. Built on an audit-grade data foundation, it automates evidence collection, maps controls across 60+ industry frameworks and custom policies, and gives teams real-time visibility into their risk and compliance posture. Where traditional tools automate workflows, Anecdotes agents execute them end to end, replacing point-in-time assessments with continuous monitoring. 
Anecdotes is the first agentic GRC platform to achieve FedRAMP 20x Class C (Moderate) Certification, bringing Continuous Control Monitoring to organizations operating under federal cloud security standards.

Tyler Federal Cloud Platform consists of the Tyler App Platform, referred to as “the Platform” (Powered by Entellitrak) software. The Platform is an enterprise level COTS (Commercial Off-The-Shelf) that provides unified BPM software by using an open architecture approach that focuses on the core technologies that streamline work for rapid application development on business processes. The Platform provides all the functionality required to collect, track, manage, process, and report on information regarding a business process. Business processes such as but not limited to “Turnkey” products, EEO complaints (EEO), Labor Relations (LR/ER), Reasonable Accommodations (RA), Veteran Benefits (VB/VBA), Background investigations (BI), Inspector General (IG), Anti-harassment (AH), Justice and Law Enforcement, and general case/record management. The Platform utilizes AWS GovCloud as its FedRAMP Authorized IaaS provider.

Valid8 Financial GovCloud is a Software-as-a-Service asset tracing and forensic accounting platform hosted in AWS GovCloud (US) within a dedicated FedRAMP authorization boundary. It supports law enforcement, financial investigations, money laundering, elder financial exploitation, healthcare fraud, embezzlement, securities fraud, drug trafficking, human trafficking, gaming, asset tracing, e-discovery, and litigation-support workflows across dozens of states. Agency-controlled evidentiary datasets are ingested into the boundary, stored in encrypted relational and object storage, and processed through the application and analytics layer to organize, trace, and produce financial information for investigative and litigation use.
The authorization boundary consists of the ingestion and intake services, the application and analytics layer, the primary relational datastore, object storage, the Keycloak identity and access management service providing authentication, multi-factor authentication, and role-based access, and the audit, logging, and continuous-monitoring services. The platform runs on a CIS-hardened baseline with FIPS-validated cryptography enforcing encryption in transit and at rest. Access is restricted to authorized agency and supporting Valid8 personnel under role-based access control. The offering is being assessed against the FedRAMP Moderate baseline.

serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Clearview GovCloud is delivered as a SaaS offering using a multi-tenant Government-Only Cloud computing environment. It is available to federal, state, local, and tribal governments to investigate crimes, enhance public safety, secure our communities and provide justice to victims.
 
Clearview AI offers  a revolutionary, web-based investigative platform for government agencies to use as a tool to help generate high-quality investigative leads. The user-friendly interface offers advanced administrative tools for oversight, reporting and compliance. To get started, a probe image is uploaded and a required intake form is completed for the agency’s oversight. A vector is created from the probe image and searched against image sources collected from the public internet or agency managed custom galleries. Potential facial image match results are returned with a source URL to the public image. The end user, as part of the human in- the-loop process, verifies and supports returned results with further investigative steps.
 
Clearview AI’s platform searches against a proprietary database of 60+ billion facial images sourced from public-only web sources, including news media, mugshot websites, public social media, and other open sources. Clearview AI’s algorithm is trained on a large, diverse, custom-built dataset of millions of facial images and is tested by NIST, achieving over 99% accuracy across all demographics.

The Optum Serve Federal Platform (OSFP) Management Plane is a centralized, multi-cloud management and security services layer that provides governance, security, and operational control across Azure Government and AWS GovCloud environments. It delivers shared services—including identity and access governance, logging and monitoring, security analytics, configuration and compliance management, and vulnerability management—to support and standardize operations for all connected systems within the enclave.

DataRobot’s DataRobot for Government is a SaaS solution that uses artificial intelligence (AI) to help businesses and teams develop, deliver, and govern AI at scale. With DataRobot for Government, customers will be able to explore, build, train, and manage advanced machine learning and generative AI models. DataRobot for Government will display the best-performing models and provide insight on how they work, allowing businesses to improve efficiency in their AI workflows. DataRobot leverages Kubernetes, powered by Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS), to set up the environment. Multiple Amazon EKS clusters and VPCs are used to provide single tenancy isolation.

The Cognition Platform (known as Devin) and accompanying suite of AI tools provide capabilities to support the software development lifecycle for U.S. federal agencies and contractors. Devin is a model‑agnostic platform that uses machine learning models and AI techniques to perform deep codebase analysis and system interpretation, as well as automated code generation, testing, review, and deployment. Granular sandboxing and enterprise controls manage AI‑generated changes and allow organizations to balance performance and cost while maintaining security and compliance requirements. The platform supports engineering and security teams in protecting their codebases, modernizing legacy languages (including COBOL and Fortran), increasing developer throughput, and accelerating migrations and application modernization activities for mission‑critical federal systems.

VisibleThread is a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application that provides automated document and language analysis for United States government contracting teams across the opportunity, capture, proposal, and contract phases of the acquisition lifecycle.

The service combines deterministic text analysis and pattern matching with generative AI functions to search, extract, draft, score, and compare document content. Analytical outputs reference the source text from which they are derived, providing traceability from each result back to the originating document.

Functional capabilities include opportunity search and bid or no-bid scoring, competitive and technical alignment analysis, compliance matrix generation and document comparison, acronym and readability analysis, terminology and tone consistency checks, AI-assisted drafting that references prior submitted content and past performance material, and contract risk and redline analysis.

Work within the service is organized into Workspaces. A Workspace is a logical container that partitions a team's content and configuration, allowing an organization to separate work by line of business, program, customer, or security boundary. Each Workspace maintains its own independent set of:

- Collections of curated reference content
- Prompt Library
- Search Dictionaries and Watchword Lists
- Contracts and reference contract sets
- Sales, capture, and proposal lifecycle stages

Access to each Workspace is controlled independently, so that content and configuration in one Workspace are not exposed to users of another. The service integrates with Microsoft SharePoint, allowing documents to be synchronized from customer-managed SharePoint locations into a Workspace's Collections for analysis.

SMX Elevate Intelligent Automation Platform (IAP) is a FedRAMP-certified PaaS that accelerates secure cloud adoption for commercial and government organizations—even in the most regulated environments. Elevate IAP integrates provisioning, monitoring, security, and lifecycle management to streamline operations, minimize complexity, and mitigate risks.

What sets Elevate IAP apart:

Built-in compliance at scale: Native controls and automations to support CMMC, HIPAA, HITECH, CJIS, PCI, SOC 1/2, FedRAMP, and DoD ILx baselines. Integrated authorization and governance: Platform-level authorization plus policy-driven guardrails simplify multi-tenant and cross-domain operations. ISV ecosystem on day one: Rapidly deploy leading solutions through the platform and partnerships — Beyond Identity, C3 AI, Cognition, ColorTokens, eShare, Versa — augmented by embedded capabilities like Dynatrace, Tenable Nessus SC and Trend Micro. Additional accredited IAP platforms deliver Appian and Juvare.

Mission-ready accelerators: Pre-built SMX solutions run natively on IAP to jumpstart outcomes:
Elevate AI: Secure Generative AI for sensitive missions
Elevate ATO Fast Track: Accelerated FedRAMP, CMMC, and DoD authorizations
Elevate FM: Financial Management
Elevate ISR: Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance
Elevate NetEdge: Global resilient networking
Elevate Sensing: Space Domain Awareness

Beyond Identity offers an authentication and access solution that maximizes phishing resistance, eliminates verifier impersonation risks, and leverages advanced cryptography to support enterprise environments seamlessly.

C3 AI enables organizations to design, develop, deploy, and operate big data, predictive analytics, AI/ML, and Internet of Things (IoT) software applications. By combining state-of-the-art foundational large language models (LLMs), deep learning retrieval models, and the C3 AI Platform, C3 Generative AI serves as a deep domain knowledge source to support information retrieval across disparate datasets and improve decision-making.

Cognition provides the Cognition Platform (known as Devin) and an accompanying suite of AI tools to accelerate the software development lifecycle. Devin is a model-agnostic platform that leverages state-of-the-art models and advanced AI capabilities to deliver deep codebase understanding, system interpretation, code generation, testing, review, and deployment. Granular sandboxing and enterprise controls prevent unauthorized propagation of AI-generated changes and allow users to balance performance and cost. Engineering and security teams rely on Cognition to autonomously defend their codebases, modernize legacy languages (COBOL, Fortran, etc.), multiply developer capacity, and accelerate migrations and application modernization efforts.

ColorTokens Xshield is a Zero Trust micro segmentation solution engineered to halt lateral movement of malware, ransomware, and other threats across cloud workloads, on premises servers, endpoints, Kubernetes containers, OT/IoT devices, and legacy systems.

eShare enables organizations to share files and collaborate using link-based access—with dynamic access controls, watermarking, and persistent policy enforcement that travel with the data even after sharing. eShare ensures regulatory compliance and governance while boosting productivity, reducing IT overhead, and maintaining full data sovereignty.

Versa Unified SASE for Government provides integrated networking and security capabilities, including:
Versa Secure SD-WAN
Versa Secure Private Access / Zero-Trust Network Access (ZTNA) / Security Services Edge (SSE)
Versa Secure Internet Access / Next-Gen Firewall as a Service (NG-FWaaS), Next-Gen Secure Web Gateway (NG-SWG)
Versa Secure Fabric / Secure Private & Internet Access (combines ZTNA and NG-SWG)
Inline Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB)
Network Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
Digital Experience Monitoring (DEM)
Centralized management and orchestration across cloud-delivered and on-premises Versa Operating System (VOS) gateways
Support for shared or dedicated deployment models

Bidscale helps federal acquisition professionals move faster across three  
high-burden workflows: Requirements Development, Acquisition Package, and 
Offer Evaluation. AI modules guide inputs, support contract data, generate stronger 
drafts, and organize evaluation records so teams can produce clear, consistent,  
and defensible outputs.

AI-Supported Acquisition Workflows
1. Requirements Development:  Guide program teams through requirements inputs, predict key contract data, and generate stronger first drafts. 
2. Acquisition Package: Support strategy decisions, assemble required materials, and create acquisition documents with configurable workflows. 
3. Offer Evaluation: Review proposals digitally, develop findings, and generate evaluation reports with a clear audit trail.

The primary purpose of the CrowdStrike Falcon Platform is to provide organizations with a comprehensive cybersecurity solution that encompasses the following system functions:

Endpoint Security - Advanced endpoint security capabilities to protect laptops, desktops, servers, and virtual machines from various cyber threats.

Threat Intelligence - Cloud-based intelligence engine to collect and analyze threat data from millions of endpoints worldwide.

Managed Security - Managed security services with a team of security experts actively monitoring and responding to security events.

Cloud Security - Cloud security capabilities to protect organizations' cloud environments.

Security and IT Operations - Integration of security and IT operations for a unified view of security posture.

Identity Protection - Identity protection capabilities to safeguard user identities and prevent unauthorized access.

Next-Gen SIEM - Logging and analysis capabilities to collect, correlate, and analyze security events and logs.

Judi Health™ is an enterprise health technology company providing benefit administration solutions to employers, health plans, unions, and government entities. Built on Judi®, a proprietary enterprise health platform, Judi Health supports healthcare benefit administration across pharmacy, medical, dental, and vision. 
 
At its core, Judi® is a modern, modular, cloud-native, secure, end-to-end platform that enables Unified Claims Processing™, bringing together medical, pharmacy, dental, and vision claims administration through a single, unified platform. Built on a fully independent and programmable REST API architecture, Judi® supports benefit administration, claims processing, payments, reporting, care navigation, consumer engagement tools, data management, and AI-powered workflows. 
 
Judi Health delivers these capabilities through three complementary business lines: 
 
• Judi Rx™ – pharmacy benefit management and administration solutions. 
• Judi Care™ – medical, dental, and vision benefit administration solutions. 
• Judi Cloud™ – the licensed SaaS offering of Judi®, enabling benefits administration and Unified Claims Processing™ across a configurable system spanning eligibility, claims, payments, reporting, and healthcare data management. 
 
By unifying medical and pharmacy data within a single platform, Judi Health reduces administrative complexity, improves transparency and operational efficiency, and provides a scalable, single source of truth for healthcare administration. Supporting commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid organizations, Judi® delivers the flexibility, scalability, and connectivity required to power modern healthcare administration.

serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Microsoft 365 (M365) Government Community Cloud (GCC) is a suite of cloud-hosted messaging and collaboration services to meet the unique and evolving requirements of the United States Federal, State, Local, and Tribal governments, as well as contractors holding or processing data on behalf of the US Government. These cloud-based services are designed to provide organizations with streamlined communication, high availability, comprehensive security, and simplified information technology (IT) management. M365 GCC provides the interactivity of on-premises client and server applications with the flexibility and scalability of web-based services. M365 GCC leverages Azure Government as the IaaS/PaaS for the underlying infrastructure and hardware. Therefore, M365 GCC relies on Azure Government-inherited services. For more information on these Azure Government services, refer to the Azure Government ATO package.
Federal agencies interested in collaborative continuous monitoring with Microsoft should reach out to: M365CollabConMon@microsoft.com

The Stell Requirements Management Software (SRMS) is delivered as a fully managed FedRAMP Moderate Equivalent software-as-a-service (“SaaS”) offering to help federal contractors meet the requirements for protecting Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI). The SRMS is a  multi-tenant Public cloud available and purpose built for commercial aerospace and defense industrial base (government and DoW contractors) partners who handle data subject to government regulations and requirements for the protection of CUI.

The Clumio Data Protection Platform is delivered as a SaaS offering using Amazon Web Services public cloud computing environment. Clumio is a backup and recovery solution that helps AWS customers build resilience into their applications, data lakes, and sensitive information. Air gapped and immutable by design, Clumio helps organizations recover from ransomware and operational disruptions, automate data compliance, and optimize storage costs.

Clumio is available to AWS customers for the public, federal, state, local, and tribal governments, as well as research institutions, federal contractors and government contractors.

Magenta is an artificial-intelligence platform developed by Magenta, headquartered in El Segundo, California, that automates document-intensive manufacturing and quality workflows for regulated manufacturing. The platform deploys specialized AI agents to perform tasks such as supplier data package review, certificate of conformance (CoC) generation, accounts payable invoice processing and purchase-order matching, non-conformance report (NCR) dispositioning, work-instruction generation, and FMEA risk-analysis documentation.

Cableteque is a SaaS platform enabling secure technical data exchange across the design-to-manufacturing lifecycle for electronics systems and assemblies. The platform supports cost estimating, design validation, manufacturability analysis, procurement automation, and manufacturing engineering workflows for defense stakeholders.

The system stores, processes, and transmitted within the system includes Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and Covered Defense Information (CDI) such as technical drawings, design specifications, bill of materials data, component and material specifications, cost and pricing data, and procurement records associated with defense electronics programs. The system also processes ITAR-regulated engineering design data.

Siteimprove Federal Platform is delivered as a Software as a Service (SaaS) offering hosted within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and made available to United States federal government agencies. The platform provides automated scanning, analysis, and reporting on federal agency website content, covering Section 508 accessibility compliance, content quality and broken-link detection. A crawler ingests content from agency websites for analysis, and findings, compliance scores, and remediation tracking are presented to agency users through a web portal. The offering processes, stores, and transmits federal customer data, including controlled unclassified information (CUI) and associated federal metadata. The production environment is deployed across a dedicated multi-account AWS organization and is built on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) for container orchestration, with self-managed Oracle databases running on Amazon EC2 dedicated hosts as the primary data store and Amazon S3 for object storage. Cryptographic protection of federal data at rest and in transit uses FIPS 140-validated modules, with key management provided through AWS Key Management Service (KMS). Service model: Software as a Service (SaaS). Deployment model: Public Cloud (AWS us-east-2 commercial region, dedicated federal AWS Organization). Customer scope: U.S. federal agencies, with a single-tenant-per-agency architecture (per-tenant AWS account and VPC).

Asato provides an AI-native, SaaS platform for enterprise IT asset management, cost intelligence, operational data products, document/contract extraction, and governed agentic workflows. The platform normalizes heterogeneous enterprise data, supports evidence-backed analytics and automation, and is designed to operate with strong governance, auditability, and tenant isolation. For federal customers, the system would store, process, and transmit enterprise operational and business data such as software asset, contract, procurement, usage, and related metadata; the exact federal data types should be finalized based on the target use case.

Halcyon's Anti-Ransomware Platform is an agent-based Software as a Service (SaaS) deployment that provides multiple layers of protection against ransomware attacks while complementing existing Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and Extended Detection and Response (XDR) solutions. The platform leverages machine learning (ML) models trained specifically to identify and disrupt ransomware activity. The solution consists of a lightweight endpoint agent that combines multiple proprietary prevention engines with ML models designed exclusively to detect ransomware throughout the attack lifecycle. The SaaS platform provides centralized policy management, security event visibility, reporting, administrative functions, and APIs, and is designed to integrate with existing security technologies and operational workflows.

Halcyon incorporates a capsule network-based machine learning architecture with the following characteristics:

Collaborative decision-making in which individual ML models communicate with one another and provide weighted decisions to improve detection accuracy.
The ability to learn and make highly accurate detection decisions using less training data than traditional convolutional neural network approaches.

Telemetry collected from protected endpoints is analyzed through multiple detection engines to evaluate process behavior over time, enabling the identification of suspicious or malicious ransomware activity. The platform supports automated response actions, including endpoint isolation, to contain ransomware activity and captures ransomware encryption key material, when available, to support recovery of encrypted data.

Halcyon Data Exfiltration Protection (DXP)

The Halcyon Data Exfiltration Protection (DXP) module extends the Anti-Ransomware Platform by detecting ransomware-related data exfiltration activity associated with double-extortion attacks. DXP analyzes network communications and process behavior to identify suspicious data movement that may indicate active ransomware operations.

DXP Capabilities:
-Detects ransomware-related data exfiltration activity before sensitive information is transmitted outside the environment.
-Supports detection and disruption of ransomware-related data theft associated with extortion campaigns.
-Provides early indication of active threat actor activity to support investigation and containment.
-Analyzes process behavior to improve detection accuracy while reducing false positives.
-Integrates with supported EDR and XDR platforms to enhance response and investigation workflows.

Ransomware Operations Center (ROC)

As part of the Halcyon Anti-Ransomware Platform, the Ransomware Operations Center (ROC) provides continuous monitoring and operational support for ransomware-related activity. The ROC reviews platform-generated detections, validates ransomware events, supports investigation, containment, recovery, and response coordination with authorized customer personnel. The ROC leverages telemetry generated by the Halcyon platform to support ransomware monitoring, response, and recovery operations on a 24x7x365 basis.

The Visionlink CommunityOS® (COS2), the Community Operating System by Visionlink, is a platform that facilitates collaboration. It allows 2-1-1 centers to share important information with homeless shelters, state governments to coordinate with local nonprofits, and emergency disaster relief agencies to connect those in need with nonprofit resources.

Praxon Arc is a secure, multi-tenant AI gateway that enables federal agencies and government contractors to access, govern, and operationalize approved generative AI models through a unified platform. Praxon provides OpenAI-compatible APIs and a centralized user interface while routing requests to authorized model providers within government cloud environments. The platform delivers centralized identity and access controls, model governance, usage monitoring, cost and budget controls, audit logging, and configurable security guardrails - allowing organizations to adopt AI without creating separate integrations or governance processes for each model provider. Praxon is designed to support secure, scalable AI deployment across federal mission, compliance, and operational use cases.

BitRip is a cloud-based asset tracking and inventory management platform that uses smart labels to bridge cloud-based data with physical assets in the field. These smart labels provide instant access to critical asset data while remaining dynamic and rugged, and they drive decision-making through enhanced, learning-based analytics. BitRip supports the Defense Logistics Agency's logistics operations under Phase 2 of R&D BAA0001-23.

trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions:
Agencies can request access by emailing **security@repl.it
or security@replit.com**. Replit's GRC team reviews each
request and grants access to the FedRAMP certification
data in the trust center.
trustCenter.agencyAccessDenialProcess:
Agencies send access requests to security@repl.it. GRC
logs and reviews each request. If GRC denies a request,
GRC notifies FedRAMP within 5 business days through the
"[CSP] Agency Access Denial" form, including the agency
name, request date, denial date and reason. GRC also
notifies the requesting agency and keeps a record of each
request, decision and notification.
